title_en: STEP: Warm-Started Visuomotor Policies with Spatiotemporal Consistency Prediction
title_zh: STEP：带时空一致性预测的热启动视觉运动策略

sentences.en: Diffusion policies have recently emerged as a powerful paradigm for visuomotor control in robotic manipulation due to their ability to model the distribution of action sequences and capture multimodality.
sentences.zh: 扩散策略近来已成为机器人操作中视觉运动控制的强大范式，因为它们能够对动作序列的分布进行建模并捕捉多模态性。

sentences.en: However, iterative denoising leads to substantial inference latency, limiting control frequency in real-time closed-loop systems.
sentences.zh: 然而，迭代去噪带来了可观的推理延迟，限制了实时闭环系统中的控制频率。

sentences.en: Existing acceleration methods either reduce sampling steps, bypass diffusion through direct prediction, or reuse past actions, but often struggle to jointly preserve action quality and achieve consistently low latency.
sentences.zh: 现有的加速方法要么减少采样步数，要么通过直接预测绕过扩散，要么复用过去的动作，但往往难以同时保持动作质量并实现持续的低延迟。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose **STEP**, a lightweight spatiotemporal consistency prediction mechanism to construct high-quality warm-start actions that are both distributionally close to the target action and temporally consistent, without compromising the generative capability of the original diffusion policy.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了 **STEP**：一种轻量级的时空一致性预测机制，用于构建高质量的热启动动作，使这些动作既在分布上接近目标动作又具有时间一致性，同时不损害原始扩散策略的生成能力。

sentences.en: Then, we propose a velocity-aware perturbation injection mechanism that adaptively modulates actuation excitation based on temporal action variation to prevent execution stall especially for real-world tasks.
sentences.zh: 随后，我们提出了一种速度感知的扰动注入机制，它根据时间动作变化自适应地调节驱动激励，以防止执行停滞，尤其适用于真实世界任务。

sentences.en: We further provide a theoretical analysis showing that the proposed prediction induces a locally contractive mapping, ensuring convergence of action errors during diffusion refinement.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步提供了理论分析，表明所提出的预测会诱导局部压缩映射，确保扩散精化过程中动作误差的收敛。

sentences.en: Extensive evaluations on nine simulated benchmarks and two real-world tasks show that STEP with 2 steps can achieve an average 21.6\% and 27.5\% higher success rate than BRIDGER and DDIM on the RoboMimic benchmark and real-world tasks, respectively.
sentences.zh: 在九个仿真基准与两个真实世界任务上的大量评估表明，采用 2 步的 STEP 在 RoboMimic 基准与真实世界任务上，分别比 BRIDGER 和 DDIM 平均高出 21.6\% 与 27.5\% 的成功率。

sentences.en: The code is available at https://github.com/Kimho666/STEP.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/Kimho666/STEP 获取。

title_en: StepCodeReasoner: Aligning Code Reasoning with Stepwise Execution Traces via Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: StepCodeReasoner：通过强化学习将代码推理与逐步执行轨迹对齐

sentences.en: Existing code reasoning methods primarily supervise final code outputs, ignoring intermediate states, often leading to reward hacking where correct answers are obtained through inconsistent reasoning.
sentences.zh: 现有的代码推理方法主要监督最终的代码输出，忽略了中间状态，常常导致奖励黑客行为：即通过不一致的推理获得正确答案。

sentences.en: We propose StepCodeReasoner, a framework that introduces explicit intermediate execution-state supervision.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 StepCodeReasoner：一个引入显式中间执行状态监督的框架。

sentences.en: By automatically inserting structured print-based execution-trace anchors into code, the model is trained to predict runtime states at each step, transforming code reasoning into a verifiable, stepwise execution modeling problem.
sentences.zh: 通过自动在代码中插入基于打印的结构化执行轨迹锚点，模型被训练以预测每一步的运行时状态，将代码推理转化为一个可验证的、逐步执行的建模问题。

sentences.en: Building on this execution-aware method, we introduce Dual-Granularity GRPO (DG-GRPO), a reinforcement learning algorithm for structured credit assignment at two complementary granularities: inter-trajectory comparison across sampled execution paths and intra-trajectory shaping based on downstream correctness.
sentences.zh: 在这一执行感知方法的基础上，我们引入了双粒度 GRPO（Dual-Granularity GRPO，DG-GRPO）：一种在两个互补粒度上进行结构化信用分配的强化学习算法——跨采样执行路径的轨迹间比较，以及基于下游正确性的轨迹内塑形。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that StepCodeReasoner achieves state-of-the-art performance in code reasoning.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，StepCodeReasoner 在代码推理中取得了最先进的性能。

sentences.en: In particular, our 7B model achieves 91.1\% on CRUXEval and 86.5\% on LiveCodeBench, outperforming the CodeReasoner-7B baseline (86.0\% and 77.7\%) and GPT-4o (85.6\% and 75.1\%).
sentences.zh: 特别地，我们的 7B 模型在 CRUXEval 上达到 91.1\%，在 LiveCodeBench 上达到 86.5\%，超越了 CodeReasoner-7B 基线（86.0\% 与 77.7\%）和 GPT-4o（85.6\% 与 75.1\%）。

sentences.en: Furthermore, on the execution-trace benchmark REval, our model scores 82.9\%, outperforming baseline CodeReasoner-7B (72.3\%), its 14B counterpart (81.1\%), and GPT-4o (77.3\%).
sentences.zh: 此外，在执行轨迹基准 REval 上，我们的模型得分为 82.9\%，超越了基线 CodeReasoner-7B（72.3\%）、其 14B 版本（81.1\%）以及 GPT-4o（77.3\%）。

sentences.en: In addition, StepCodeReasoner improves code generation, achieving 90.1 on HumanEval, 85.0 on MBPP, and 19.4 on LiveCodeBench generation, with an average score of 64.8 versus 62.6 for CodeReasoner-7B.
sentences.zh: 此外，StepCodeReasoner 还提升了代码生成能力，在 HumanEval 上达到 90.1，在 MBPP 上达到 85.0，在 LiveCodeBench 生成上达到 19.4，平均得分 64.8，而 CodeReasoner-7B 为 62.6。

title_en: StethoLM: Audio Language Model for Cardiopulmonary Analysis Across Clinical Tasks
title_zh: StethoLM：面向跨临床任务心肺分析的音频语言模型

sentences.en: Listening to heart and lung sounds — auscultation — is one of the first and most fundamental steps in a clinical examination.
sentences.zh: 听心音与肺音——即听诊——是临床检查中最基础也最关键的初始步骤之一。

sentences.en: Despite being fast and non-invasive, it demands years of experience to interpret subtle audio cues.
sentences.zh: 尽管听诊快速且无创，但解读细腻的音频线索需要多年的经验。

sentences.en: Recent deep learning methods have made progress in automating cardiopulmonary sound analysis, yet most are restricted to simple classification and offer little clinical interpretability or decision support.
sentences.zh: 近期的深度学习方法在自动化心肺音分析方面取得了进展，但大多数仅限于简单的分类，提供的临床可解释性或决策支持很少。

sentences.en: We present StethoLM, the first audio–language model specialized for cardiopulmonary auscultation, capable of performing instruction-driven clinical tasks across the full spectrum of auscultation analysis.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 StethoLM：首个专用于心肺听诊的音频-语言模型，它能够跨听诊分析的完整范围执行指令驱动的临床任务。

sentences.en: StethoLM integrates audio encoding with a medical language model backbone and is trained on StethoBench, a comprehensive benchmark comprising 77,027 instruction–response pairs synthesized from 16,125 labeled cardiopulmonary recordings spanning seven clinical task categories: binary classification, detection, reporting, reasoning, differential diagnosis, comparison, and location-based analysis.
sentences.zh: StethoLM 将音频编码与医学语言模型骨干相结合，并在 StethoBench 上训练：这是一个综合基准，包含由 16,125 段带标签心肺录音合成的 77,027 个指令-响应对，涵盖七类临床任务——二分类、检测、报告、推理、鉴别诊断、比较与基于位置的分析。

sentences.en: Through multi-stage training that combines supervised fine-tuning and direct preference optimization, StethoLM achieves substantial gains in performance and robustness on out-of-distribution data.
sentences.zh: 通过结合监督微调与直接偏好优化的多阶段训练，StethoLM 在分布外数据上取得了显著的性能与鲁棒性提升。

sentences.en: Our work establishes a foundation for instruction-following AI systems in clinical auscultation.
sentences.zh: 我们的工作为临床听诊中的指令跟随 AI 系统奠定了基础。

title_en: STFlow: Data-Coupled Flow Matching for Geometric Trajectory Simulation
title_zh: STFlow：用于几何轨迹模拟的数据耦合流匹配

sentences.en: Simulating trajectories of dynamical systems is a fundamental problem in a wide range of fields such as molecular dynamics, biochemistry, and pedestrian dynamics.
sentences.zh: 模拟动力学系统的轨迹是分子动力学、生物化学与行人动力学等多个领域的基础问题。

sentences.en: Machine learning has become an invaluable tool for scaling physics-based simulators and developing models directly from experimental data.
sentences.zh: 机器学习已成为扩展基于物理的模拟器以及直接从实验数据开发模型的宝贵工具。

sentences.en: In particular, recent advances in deep generative modeling and geometric deep learning enable probabilistic simulation by learning complex trajectory distributions while respecting intrinsic permutation and time-shift symmetries.
sentences.zh: 特别是，深度生成建模与几何深度学习的最新进展，使我们能够通过学习复杂的轨迹分布来进行概率模拟，同时尊重固有的置换与时间平移对称性。

sentences.en: However, trajectories of N-body systems are commonly characterized by high sensitivity to perturbations leading to bifurcations, as well as multi-scale temporal and spatial correlations.
sentences.zh: 然而，N 体系统的轨迹通常以对扰动的高敏感性为特征，这会导致分叉，同时还具有多尺度的时间与空间相关性。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, we introduce STFlow (Spatio-Temporal Flow), a generative model based on graph neural networks and hierarchical convolutions.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们引入了 STFlow（Spatio-Temporal Flow，时空流）：一个基于图神经网络与分层卷积的生成模型。

sentences.en: By incorporating data-dependent couplings within the Flow Matching framework, STFlow denoises starting from conditioned random-walks instead of Gaussian noise.
sentences.zh: 通过在流匹配（Flow Matching）框架中引入数据依赖的耦合，STFlow 从条件随机游走而非高斯噪声出发进行去噪。

sentences.en: This novel informed prior simplifies the learning task by reducing transport cost, increasing training and inference efficiency.
sentences.zh: 这种新颖的信息化先验通过降低传输代价简化了学习任务，提升了训练与推理效率。

sentences.en: We validate our approach on N-body systems, molecular dynamics, and human trajectory forecasting.
sentences.zh: 我们在 N 体系统、分子动力学与人类轨迹预测上验证了我们的方法。

sentences.en: Across these benchmarks, STFlow achieves the lowest prediction errors with fewer simulation steps and improved scalability.
sentences.zh: 在这些基准上，STFlow 以更少的模拟步骤取得了最低的预测误差，并具有更好的可扩展性。

title_en: StitchCUDA: An Automated Multi-Agents End-to-End GPU Programing Framework with Rubric-based Agentic Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: StitchCUDA：基于评分细则的智能体强化学习的自动化多智能体端到端 GPU 编程框架

sentences.en: Modern machine learning (ML) workloads increasingly rely on GPUs, yet achieving high end-to-end performance remains challenging due to dependencies on both GPU kernel efficiency and host-side settings.
sentences.zh: 现代机器学习（ML）工作负载越来越依赖 GPU，然而由于同时依赖 GPU 内核效率与主机端设置，实现高的端到端性能仍然颇具挑战。

sentences.en: Although LLM-based methods show promise on automated GPU kernel generation, prior works mainly focus on single-kernel optimization and do not extend to end-to-end programs, hindering practical deployment.
sentences.zh: 尽管基于 LLM 的方法在自动化 GPU 内核生成方面显示出前景，但先前的工作主要聚焦于单内核优化，并未扩展到端到端程序，阻碍了实际部署。

sentences.en: To address the challenge, in this work, we propose \textsc{StitchCUDA}, a multi-agent framework for end-to-end GPU program generation, with three specialized agents: a \textit{Planner} to orchestrate whole system design, a \textit{Coder} dedicated to implementing it step-by-step, and a \textit{Verifier} for correctness check and performance profiling using Nsys/NCU.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一挑战，在这项工作中，我们提出了 \textsc{StitchCUDA}：一个用于端到端 GPU 程序生成的多智能体框架，包含三个专业智能体：\textit{Planner}（规划器）负责编排整体系统设计，\textit{Coder}（编码器）致力于逐步实现系统，\textit{Verifier}（验证器）使用 Nsys/NCU 进行正确性检查与性能剖析。

sentences.en: To fundamentally improve the \textit{Coder}'s ability in end-to-end GPU programming, \textsc{StitchCUDA} integrates rubric-based agentic reinforcement learning over two atomic skills, task-to-code generation and feedback-driven code optimization, with combined rubric reward and rule-based reward from real executions.
sentences.zh: 为从根本上提升 \textit{Coder} 在端到端 GPU 编程中的能力，\textsc{StitchCUDA} 集成了基于评分细则的智能体强化学习，涵盖两个原子技能：任务到代码生成与反馈驱动的代码优化，奖励由评分细则奖励与来自真实执行的基于规则奖励组合而成。

sentences.en: Therefore, the \textit{Coder} learns how to implement advanced CUDA programming techniques (e.g., custom kernel fusion, cublas epilogue), and we also effectively prevent \textit{Coder}'s reward hacking (e.g., just copy PyTorch code or hardcoding output) during benchmarking.
sentences.zh: 因此，\textit{Coder} 学会了如何实现高级 CUDA 编程技术（例如自定义内核融合、cublas 收尾操作），同时我们还能在基准评测期间有效防止 \textit{Coder} 的奖励黑客行为（例如直接复制 PyTorch 代码或硬编码输出）。

sentences.en: Experiments on KernelBench show that \textsc{StitchCUDA} achieves nearly 100\% success rate on end-to-end GPU programming tasks, with 1.72$\times$  better speedup over the multi-agent baseline and 2.73$\times$ than the RL model baselines.
sentences.zh: 在 KernelBench 上的实验表明，\textsc{StitchCUDA} 在端到端 GPU 编程任务上达到了接近 100\% 的成功率，加速比分别比多智能体基线高 1.72$\times$、比 RL 模型基线高 2.73$\times$。

title_en: STLA: Spatiotemporal Lookahead Alignment for Post-Training Quantization
title_zh: STLA：训练后量化的时空前视对齐

sentences.en: Adaptive rounding techniques in Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) enable the efficient deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) with low resource and data dependencies.
sentences.zh: 训练后量化（Post-Training Quantization，PTQ）中的自适应舍入技术使大语言模型（LLM）的低资源、低数据依赖的高效部署成为可能。

sentences.en: While learning-based rounding methods are accurate yet costly, compensation-based approaches offer a highly efficient alternative.
sentences.zh: 基于学习的舍入方法虽然准确但成本高昂，而基于补偿的方法则提供了高效的替代方案。

sentences.en: However, synergizing these two to realize their full potential is hindered by spatiotemporal misalignment in the decoupled paradigm.
sentences.zh: 然而，在解耦范式中，时空错位阻碍了这两种方法的协同以发挥其全部潜力。

sentences.en: Key challenges include temporal parameter conflict, the invalidation of the initial Round-to-Nearest (RTN) assumption, and spatially-inconsistent optimization objectives.
sentences.zh: 关键挑战包括时间参数冲突、初始舍入到最近（Round-to-Nearest，RTN）假设的失效，以及空间上不一致的优化目标。

sentences.en: This paper introduces STLA, a novel rounding-optimized PTQ framework that achieves both fast and accurate LLM quantization.
sentences.zh: 本文介绍了 STLA：一个新颖的舍入优化 PTQ 框架，它同时实现了快速与准确的 LLM 量化。

sentences.en: STLA resolves temporal inconsistency through cluster-wise integrated rounding optimization, which collocates the learning and compensation phases.
sentences.zh: STLA 通过簇级集成舍入优化化解时间不一致性，该优化将学习阶段与补偿阶段置于同一位置。

sentences.en: STLA achieves spatial alignment through a unified global objective derived from the Schur Complement, enabling the solver to look ahead and align local rounding decisions with the optimal future compensation of remaining weights.
sentences.zh: STLA 通过从 Schur 补导出的统一全局目标实现空间对齐，使求解器能够前视并将局部舍入决策与剩余权重的最优未来补偿对齐。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we propose a Hessian-guided clustering strategy that exploits both diagonal and off-diagonal information to maximize intra-cluster error cancellation.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们提出了一种 Hessian 引导的聚类策略，它同时利用对角与非对角信息以最大化簇内误差抵消。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that STLA establishes a new state-of-the-art for low-bit PTQ while maintaining high computational efficiency.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，STLA 在保持高计算效率的同时，为低比特 PTQ 确立了新的最先进水平。

sentences.en: The code is available at https://github.com/AI2C-Lab/STLA.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/AI2C-Lab/STLA 获取。

title_en: Stochastic Gradient Methods under Heavy-Tailed Noises in Weakly Convex Optimization
title_zh: 弱凸优化中重尾噪声下的随机梯度方法

sentences.en: Recently, many empirical work has shown that, in machine learning, the noise distribution of stochastic gradients often exhibits heavy tails when stochastic optimization methods are employed.
sentences.zh: 近来，许多实证工作表明，在机器学习中，当采用随机优化方法时，随机梯度的噪声分布常常呈现重尾特性。

sentences.en: Most existing theoretical analyses of heavy-tailed stochastic methods rely on various convexity and smoothness assumptions and our knowledge of how heavy-tailed stochastic methods behave in the setting of weakly convex optimization is still limited.
sentences.zh: 现有关于重尾随机方法的大多数理论分析依赖于各种凸性与光滑性假设，而我们对重尾随机方法在弱凸优化设置下表现的认识仍然有限。

sentences.en: In the weakly convex setting, this paper derives new upper bounds on the convergence of the stochastic gradient method (SGD) under heavy-tailed noises.
sentences.zh: 在弱凸设置下，本文推导了重尾噪声下随机梯度方法（SGD）收敛速度的新上界。

sentences.en: In particular, for vanilla SGD, we establish an in-expectation convergence guarantee on the bounded constrained domain under the assumption of bounded $p$-th central moment ($p$-BCM) of the gradient noise, and a high-probability guarantee on the unbounded domain when the noise follows a heavy-tailed sub-Weibull distribution.
sentences.zh: 特别地，对于普通 SGD，我们在梯度噪声的 $p$ 阶中心矩有界（$p$-BCM）假设下，在有界约束域上建立了期望意义下的收敛保证；当噪声服从重尾亚威布尔分布时，在无界域上建立了高概率保证。

sentences.en: By equipping SGD with the gradient clipping (Clip-SGD), we demonstrate that it achieves high-probability convergence in the unbounded domain under the $p$-BCM gradient noise.
sentences.zh: 通过将 SGD 与梯度裁剪相结合（Clip-SGD），我们证明它在 $p$-BCM 梯度噪声下能够于无界域实现高概率收敛。

sentences.en: All of our high-probability convergence bounds depend on the failure probability only through polynomial-logarithmic factors.
sentences.zh: 我们的所有高概率收敛界对失败概率的依赖仅通过多项式-对数因子体现。

sentences.en: Finally, we present experiments to validate our theoretical findings.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们通过实验验证了我们的理论发现。

title_en: Stochastic Gradient Variational Inference with Price's Gradient Estimator from Bures-Wasserstein to Parameter Space
title_zh: 使用 Price 梯度估计器的随机梯度变分推断：从 Bures-Wasserstein 空间到参数空间

sentences.en: For approximating a target distribution given only its unnormalized log-density, stochastic gradient-based variational inference (VI) algorithms are a popular approach.
sentences.zh: 在仅给定未归一化对数密度的情况下近似目标分布，基于随机梯度的变分推断（VI）算法是一种流行的方法。

sentences.en: For example, Wasserstein VI (WVI) and black-box VI (BBVI) perform gradient descent in measure space (Bures-Wasserstein space) and parameter space, respectively.
sentences.zh: 例如，Wasserstein VI（WVI）与黑盒 VI（BBVI）分别在测度空间（Bures-Wasserstein 空间）与参数空间中执行梯度下降。

sentences.en: Previously, for the Gaussian variational family, convergence guarantees for WVI have shown superiority over existing results for black-box VI with the reparametrization gradient, suggesting the measure space approach might provide some unique benefits.
sentences.zh: 此前，对于高斯变分族，WVI 的收敛保证显示出优于带重参数化梯度的黑盒 VI 现有结果，这表明测度空间方法可能具有某些独特的优势。

sentences.en: In this work, however, we close this gap by obtaining identical state-of-the-art iteration complexity guarantees for both.
sentences.zh: 然而，在这项工作中，我们通过为两者获得相同的、最先进的迭代复杂度保证来弥合这一差距。

sentences.en: In particular, we identify that WVI's superiority stems from the specific gradient estimator it uses, which BBVI can also leverage with minor modifications.
sentences.zh: 特别地，我们识别出 WVI 的优势源于它所使用的特定梯度估计器，而 BBVI 只需稍作修改也能利用该估计器。

sentences.en: The estimator in question is usually associated with Price's theorem and utilizes second-order information (Hessians) of the target log-density.
sentences.zh: 该估计器通常与 Price 定理相关联，并利用目标对数密度的二阶信息（Hessian）。

sentences.en: We will refer to this as Price's gradient.
sentences.zh: 我们将其称为 Price 梯度（Price's gradient）。

sentences.en: On the flip side, WVI can be made more widely applicable by using the reparametrization gradient, which requires only gradients of the log-density.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，通过使用仅需对数密度梯度的重参数化梯度，WVI 可以获得更广泛的适用性。

sentences.en: We empirically demonstrate that the use of Price's gradient is the major source of performance improvement.
sentences.zh: 我们实证表明，使用 Price 梯度是性能提升的主要来源。

title_en: Stochastic Lifting for Generating Trajectories of Stochastic Physical Systems
title_zh: 用于生成随机物理系统轨迹的随机提升

sentences.en: Many stochastic physical systems evolve smoothly over time in the sense that the distribution of states changes regularly with time.
sentences.zh: 许多随机物理系统随时间平滑演化，即状态的分布随时间有规律地变化。

sentences.en: The precise transition from current to next state is often modeled as the interplay of a smooth map and an explicit source of randomness.
sentences.zh: 从当前状态到下一状态的精确转移常常被建模为平滑映射与显式随机源的相互作用。

sentences.en: Stochastic Lifting leverages this premise by attaching an independent, high-dimensional random label to each state transition in the training data and fitting a transition map from the current state and label to the next state using a standard regression loss.
sentences.zh: 随机提升（Stochastic Lifting）利用这一前提：为训练数据中的每个状态转移附加一个独立的高维随机标签，并使用标准回归损失拟合从当前状态与标签到下一状态的转移映射。

sentences.en: The labels act as auxiliary coordinates that let the model represent multiple plausible outcomes for similar current states, avoiding collapse to a mean prediction in the finite-sample size regime.
sentences.zh: 这些标签充当辅助坐标，使模型能够为相似的当前状态表示多种合理的结果，避免在有限样本规模下坍缩为均值预测。

sentences.en: At inference, drawing fresh labels and rolling the map forward generates diverse trajectories with a single network evaluation per time step, with the smoothness bias of the learned map supporting accurate sampling in practice.
sentences.zh: 在推理时，抽取新的标签并将映射向前推进，即可在每个时间步仅经过一次网络评估的情况下生成多样化的轨迹，而学习到的映射的平滑性偏差在实际中支持了准确的采样。

title_en: Stochastic Linear Bandits with Parameter Noise
title_zh: 带参数噪声的随机线性老虎机

sentences.en: We study the stochastic linear bandits with parameter noise model, in which the reward of action $a$ is $a^\top \theta$ where $\theta$ is sampled i.i.d. We show a regret upper bound of $\widetilde{O} (\sqrt{d T \log(K/\delta) \sigma^2_{\max}})$ for a horizon $T$, general action set of size $K$ of dimension $d$, and where $\sigma^2_{\max}$ is the maximal variance of the reward for any action.
sentences.zh: 我们研究带参数噪声模型的随机线性老虎机，其中动作 $a$ 的奖励为 $a^\top \theta$，而 $\theta$ 是独立同分布采样的。对于视界 $T$、大小为 $K$ 且维度为 $d$ 的一般动作集，其中 $\sigma^2_{\max}$ 是任意动作奖励的最大方差，我们给出了遗憾上界 $\widetilde{O} (\sqrt{d T \log(K/\delta) \sigma^2_{\max}})$。

sentences.en: We further provide a lower bound of $\widetilde{\Omega} (d \sqrt{T \sigma_{\max}^2})$ which is tight (up to logarithmic factors) whenever $\log K \approx d$.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步给出下界 $\widetilde{\Omega} (d \sqrt{T \sigma_{\max}^2})$，只要 $\log K \approx d$，该下界（在取对数因子意义上）就是紧的。

sentences.en: For more specific action sets, $\ell_p$ unit balls with $p \leq 2$ and dual norm $q$, we show that the minimax regret is $\widetilde{\Theta} (\sqrt{dT \sigma_q^2})$, where $\sigma_q^2$ is a variance-dependent quantity that is always at most $4$.
sentences.zh: 对于更具体的动作集：具有 $p \leq 2$ 与对偶范数 $q$ 的 $\ell_p$ 单位球，我们证明极小极大遗憾为 $\widetilde{\Theta} (\sqrt{dT \sigma_q^2})$，其中 $\sigma_q^2$ 是一个依赖于方差的量，且始终不超过 $4$。

sentences.en: This is in contrast to the minimax regret attainable for such sets in the classic additive noise model where the regret is of order $d \sqrt{T}$.
sentences.zh: 这与经典加性噪声模型中此类动作集可达到的极小极大遗憾形成对比，后者的遗憾阶为 $d \sqrt{T}$。

sentences.en: Surprisingly, we show that this optimal (up to logarithmic factors) regret bound is attainable using a very simple explore-exploit algorithm.
sentences.zh: 令人惊讶的是，我们表明这个最优（在取对数因子意义上）的遗憾界可以用一种非常简单的探索-利用算法即可达到。

title_en: Stochastic Minimum-Cost Reach-Avoid Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 随机最小代价到达-规避强化学习

sentences.en: We study stochastic minimum-cost reach-avoid reinforcement learning, where an agent must satisfy a reach-avoid specification with probability at least $p$ while minimizing expected cumulative costs in stochastic environments.
sentences.zh: 我们研究随机最小代价的到达-规避（reach-avoid）强化学习，其中智能体必须以至少 $p$ 的概率满足到达-规避规范，同时在随机环境中最小化期望累积代价。

sentences.en: Existing safe and constrained reinforcement learning methods typically fail to jointly enforce probabilistic reach-avoid constraints and optimize cost in the learning setting in stochastic environments.
sentences.zh: 现有的安全与受限强化学习方法在随机环境的学习场景中通常无法同时强制执行概率性到达-规避约束并优化代价。

sentences.en: To address this challenge, we introduce reach-avoid probability certificates (RAPCs), which identify states from which stochastic reach-avoid constraints are satisfiable.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一挑战，我们引入了到达-规避概率证书（Reach-Avoid Probability Certificates，RAPC），它识别出随机到达-规避约束可满足的状态。

sentences.en: Building on RAPCs, we develop a contraction-based Bellman formulation that serves as a principled surrogate for integrating reach-avoid considerations into reinforcement learning, enabling cost optimization under probabilistic constraints.
sentences.zh: 基于 RAPC，我们开发了一种基于压缩的 Bellman 形式，它作为将到达-规避考量整合进强化学习的规范替代，能够在概率约束下实现代价优化。

sentences.en: We establish almost sure convergence of the proposed algorithms to locally optimal policies with respect to the resulting objective.
sentences.zh: 我们建立了所提出算法在所得目标下几乎必然收敛到局部最优策略的保证。

sentences.en: Experiments in the MuJoCo simulator demonstrate improved cost performance and consistently higher reach-avoid satisfaction rates.
sentences.zh: 在 MuJoCo 模拟器中的实验表明，我们的方法改善了代价性能，并始终取得更高的到达-规避满足率。

title_en: Stochastic Neural Ray Tracing for Radio Frequency Channel Modeling
title_zh: 用于射频信道建模的随机神经光线追踪

sentences.en: Wireless channel modeling is essential for the design, analysis, and optimization of modern wireless sensing and communication systems.
sentences.zh: 无线信道建模对于现代无线感知与通信系统的设计、分析与优化至关重要。

sentences.en: However, accurately modeling wireless channels in electrically large and complex environments remains a long-standing challenge, owing to the intricate interactions between radio-frequency (RF) signals and surrounding objects (e.g., reflection, diffraction, and scattering).
sentences.zh: 然而，由于射频（RF）信号与周围物体之间的复杂交互（例如反射、衍射与散射），在电大且复杂的环境中精确建模无线信道仍然是一个长期挑战。

sentences.en: Unlike conventional ray-tracing pipelines that rely on hand-engineer interaction rules, or black-box neural surrogates that do not explicitly model physical structure, we introduce SNRFT, a novel framework that integrates neural representations with physics-based RF propagation modeling.
sentences.zh: 与依赖手工设计交互规则的常规光线追踪流水线、或未显式建模物理结构的黑盒神经替代模型不同，我们引入了 SNRFT：一个将神经表示与基于物理的 RF 传播建模相结合的新颖框架。

sentences.en: Our key idea is to view RF transport as a stochastic propagation process, from which a material-dependent attenuation coefficient emerges naturally as the rate parameter governing transport dynamics.
sentences.zh: 我们的关键思想是将 RF 传输视为一个随机传播过程，从中自然地涌现出依赖材料的衰减系数，作为支配传播动力学的速率参数。

sentences.en: This formulation inherently satisfies key physical constraints such as reciprocity and reversibility.
sentences.zh: 这种形式天然满足互易性与可逆性等关键物理约束。

sentences.en: Building on this foundation, we employ implicit neural representations to capture complex RF-object interactions while preserving the composability of traditional ray tracing.
sentences.zh: 在这一基础之上，我们采用隐式神经表示来捕捉复杂的 RF-物体交互，同时保留传统光线追踪的可组合性。

sentences.en: Extensive evaluations on real-world wireless communication and sensing testbeds demonstrate that SNRFT consistently outperforms existing methods, while requiring significantly fewer training samples.
sentences.zh: 在真实世界无线通信与感知测试平台上的大量评估表明，SNRFT 始终优于现有方法，同时所需的训练样本显著更少。

title_en: Stochastic Order Learning: An Approach to Rank Estimation Using Noisy Data
title_zh: 随机序学习：一种使用带噪数据的排序估计方法

sentences.en: Rank estimation under label noise poses a fundamental challenge, as ordinal annotations often exhibit structured uncertainty rather than simple label corruption.
sentences.zh: 标签噪声下的排序估计是一个根本性挑战，因为序数标注往往表现出结构化的不确定性，而非简单的标签损坏。

sentences.en: In this paper, we reformulate rank estimation with noisy ordinal labels as a stochastic ordering problem, in which each instance is inherently associated with multiple plausible ranks instead of a single deterministic label.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们将带噪序数标签的排序估计重新表述为一个随机排序问题，其中每个实例本质上与多个可能排序相关联，而非单一的确定性标签。

sentences.en: Based on this view, we propose stochastic order learning (SOL), a learning framework that captures ordinal label uncertainty and learns an embedding space through two complementary objectives: a discriminative loss that structures instance-centroid interactions and a stochastic order loss that enforces probabilistic ordering relations between instances.
sentences.zh: 基于这一视角，我们提出了随机序学习（Stochastic Order Learning，SOL）：一个学习框架，它捕获序数标签的不确定性，并通过两个互补目标学习嵌入空间：一个结构化实例-质心交互的判别损失，以及一个在实例之间强制执行概率排序关系的随机序损失。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across diverse datasets demonstrate that SOL enables reliable rank estimation under various types and levels of label noise.
sentences.zh: 在多种数据集上的大量实验表明，SOL 能够在各种类型与水平的标签噪声下实现可靠的排序估计。

sentences.en: The source code is available at https://github.com/cwlee00/SOL.
sentences.zh: 源代码可在 https://github.com/cwlee00/SOL 获取。

title_en: Stochastic Sparse Attention for Memory-Bound Inference
title_zh: 面向内存受限推理的随机稀疏注意力

sentences.en: Autoregressive decoding becomes bandwidth-limited at long contexts, as generating each token requires reading all $n_k$ key and value vectors from KV cache.
sentences.zh: 在长上下文中，自回归解码会受带宽限制，因为生成每个词元都需要从 KV 缓存中读取全部 $n_k$ 个键与值向量。

sentences.en: We present Stochastic Additive No-mulT Attention (SANTA), a method that sparsifies value-cache access by sampling $S \ll n_k$ indices from the post-softmax distribution and aggregates only those value rows.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了随机加性无乘法注意力（Stochastic Additive No-mulT Attention，SANTA）：一种通过从 softmax 后分布中采样 $S \ll n_k$ 个索引并仅聚合这些值行来稀疏化值缓存访问的方法。

sentences.en: This yields an unbiased estimator of the post-softmax value aggregation while replacing value-stage multiply-accumulates with gather-and-add.
sentences.zh: 这产生了 softmax 后值聚合的无偏估计器，同时用收集-相加取代值阶段的乘加运算。

sentences.en: We introduce stratified and systematic sampling to design variance-reduced, GPU-friendly variants.
sentences.zh: 我们引入分层采样与系统采样，以设计方差缩减、GPU 友好的变体。

sentences.en: Evaluated on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct at 32k-token contexts, S$^2$ANTA matches baseline accuracy while achieving up to $1.5\times$ decode-step attention-kernel speedup over FlashInfer and FlashDecoding on an NVIDIA RTX 6000 Ada.
sentences.zh: 在 32k 词元上下文下对 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 的评估表明，S$^2$ANTA 在匹配基线准确率的同时，在 NVIDIA RTX 6000 Ada 上相比 FlashInfer 与 FlashDecoding 实现了最高 $1.5\times$ 的解码步注意力内核加速。

sentences.en: In batched long-context generation, these kernel gains translate to up to $1.25\times$ end-to-end decode-latency speedup.
sentences.zh: 在批量长上下文生成中，这些内核收益转化为最高 $1.25\times$ 的端到端解码延迟加速。

sentences.en: Finally, we propose Bernoulli $qK^\mathsf{T}$ sampling as a complementary technique to sparsify the score stage, reducing key-feature access through stochastic ternary queries.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们提出伯努利 $qK^\mathsf{T}$ 采样作为稀疏化分数阶段的补充技术，通过随机三元查询减少键特征访问。

sentences.en: Both methods are complementary to upstream  quantization, low-rank projection, KV-cache compression, and KV-cache selection methods.
sentences.zh: 这两种方法都与上游量化、低秩投影、KV 缓存压缩与 KV 缓存选择方法互补。

sentences.en: Together, they point toward sparse, multiplier-free, and energy-efficient inference.
sentences.zh: 两者共同指向了稀疏、无乘法且能效高的推理。

sentences.en: We open-source our kernels at: https://github.com/OPUSLab/SANTA.git
sentences.zh: 我们在 https://github.com/OPUSLab/SANTA.git 开源了我们的内核。

title_en: Stop the Flip-Flop: Context-Preserving Verification for Fast Revocable Diffusion Decoding
title_zh: 停止翻转变动：面向快速可撤销扩散解码的上下文保持验证

sentences.en: Parallel diffusion decoding can accelerate diffusion language model inference by unmasking multiple tokens per step, but aggressive parallelism often harms quality.
sentences.zh: 并行扩散解码通过每步揭示多个词元可以加速扩散语言模型的推理，但激进的并行化常常损害质量。

sentences.en: Revocable decoding mitigates this by rechecking earlier tokens, yet we observe that existing verification schemes frequently trigger flip-flop oscillations, where tokens are remasked and later restored unchanged.
sentences.zh: 可撤销解码通过重新检查较早的词元来缓解这一问题，然而我们观察到现有的验证方案常常触发翻转变动振荡，其中词元被重新掩蔽并在之后原样恢复。

sentences.en: This behaviour slows inference in two ways: remasking verified positions weakens the conditioning context for parallel drafting, and repeated remask cycles consume the revision budget with little net progress.
sentences.zh: 这种行为从两个方面拖慢推理：重新掩蔽已验证位置会削弱并行草拟的条件上下文，而重复的再掩蔽循环消耗修订预算却几乎没有净进展。

sentences.en: We propose COVER (Cache Override Verification for Efficient Revision), which performs leave-one-out verification and stable drafting within a single forward pass.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 COVER（Cache Override Verification for Efficient Revision，高效修订的缓存覆盖验证），它在单次前向传播内执行留一验证与稳定草拟。

sentences.en: COVER constructs two attention views via KV cache override: selected seeds are masked for verification, while their cached key value states are injected for all other queries to preserve contextual information, with a closed form diagonal correction preventing self leakage at the seed positions.
sentences.zh: COVER 通过 KV 缓存覆盖构造两种注意力视图：所选种子被掩蔽以进行验证，而其缓存的键值状态则注入所有其他查询以保留上下文信息，并通过闭式对角校正防止种子位置处的自泄漏。

sentences.en: COVER further prioritises seeds using a stability aware score that balances uncertainty, downstream influence, and cache drift, and it adapts the number of verified seeds per step.
sentences.zh: COVER 进一步使用一个在不确定性、下游影响与缓存漂移之间取得平衡的稳定性感知分数对种子进行排序，并自适应调整每步验证的种子数量。

sentences.en: Across benchmarks, COVER markedly reduces unnecessary revisions and yields faster decoding while preserving output quality.
sentences.zh: 在多个基准上，COVER 显著减少了不必要的修订，在保持输出质量的同时实现了更快的解码。

title_en: Stop Training for the Worst: Progressive Unmasking Accelerates Masked Diffusion Training
title_zh: 不要为最坏情况训练：渐进去掩蔽加速掩蔽扩散训练

sentences.en: Masked Diffusion Models (MDMs) have emerged as a promising approach for generative modeling in discrete spaces.
sentences.zh: 掩蔽扩散模型（Masked Diffusion Model，MDM）已成为离散空间中生成建模的一种有前景的方法。

sentences.en: By generating sequences in any order and allowing for parallel decoding, they enable fast inference and strong performance on non-causal tasks.
sentences.zh: 通过以任意顺序生成序列并允许并行解码，它们在非因果任务上实现了快速推理与强大性能。

sentences.en: However, this flexibility comes with a *training complexity* trade-off: MDMs train on an exponentially large set of masking patterns, which is not only computationally expensive, but also creates a train--test mismatch between the random masks used in training and the highly structured masks induced by inference-time unmasking.
sentences.zh: 然而，这种灵活性带来了*训练复杂度*上的权衡：MDM 在指数级庞大的掩蔽模式集合上进行训练，这不仅计算开销高昂，还会在训练所用随机掩码与推理时去掩蔽所产生的高度结构化掩码之间形成训练-测试不匹配。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose Progressive UnMAsking (PUMA), a simple modification of the forward masking process that aligns training-time and inference-time masking patterns, thereby focusing optimization on *inference-aligned masks* and speeding up training.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了渐进去掩蔽（Progressive UnMAsking，PUMA）：对前向掩蔽过程的简单修改，它使训练时与推理时的掩蔽模式对齐，从而将优化集中于*推理对齐掩码*并加速训练。

sentences.en: Empirically, PUMA speeds up pretraining at the 125M scale by  $\approx 2.3 \times$  and offers complementary advantages on top of common recipes like autoregressive initialization.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，PUMA 在 125M 规模上使预训练加速约 $\approx 2.3 \times$，并在自回归初始化等常见方法之上提供了互补优势。

sentences.en: We open-source our codebase at https://github.com/JaeyeonKim01/PUMA.
sentences.zh: 我们在 https://github.com/JaeyeonKim01/PUMA 开源了我们的代码库。

title_en: Stop When Further Reasoning Won’t Help: Attention-State Adaptive Generation in Reasoning Models
title_zh: 当进一步推理无益时停止：推理模型中的注意力状态自适应生成

sentences.en: By incorporating test-time compute scaling, large reasoning models (LRMs) are able to solve complex problems by generating explicit chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning processes.
sentences.zh: 通过引入测试时计算扩展，大型推理模型（LRM）能够通过生成显式的思维链（CoT）推理过程来解决复杂问题。

sentences.en: However, they often suffer from overthinking during generation, resulting in redundant token outputs and degraded accuracy.
sentences.zh: 然而，它们在生成过程中常常遭受过度思考的困扰，导致冗余的词元输出与准确率下降。

sentences.en: Existing methods to mitigate this issue remain limited: training-based approaches incur substantial training costs, while training-free methods often rely on well-crafted prompting or unreliable confidence signals.
sentences.zh: 缓解这一问题的现有方法仍然有限：基于训练的方法需要可观的训练成本，而免训练方法往往依赖精心设计的提示或不可靠的置信度信号。

sentences.en: In this work, we study early stopping through attention distributions and propose a simple method, ASAG, that infers the model's reasoning state and adaptively adjusts the generation strategy.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们通过注意力分布研究早期停止，并提出一种简单的方法 ASAG，它推断模型的推理状态并自适应地调整生成策略。

sentences.en: The proposed method is training-free and plug-and-play, enabling seamless integration into existing LRMs.
sentences.zh: 所提出的方法是免训练且即插即用的，能够无缝集成到现有的 LRM 中。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on nine benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements across mainstream LRMs with varying parameter scales, including the Deepseek-R1-Distill and Qwen3 series.
sentences.zh: 在九个基准上的大量实验表明，该方法在包括 Deepseek-R1-Distill 与 Qwen3 系列在内的、参数规模各异的主流 LRM 上取得了持续改进。

sentences.en: In particular, ASAG achieves a 4.4% relative improvement in accuracy while reducing the number of generated tokens by over 40% across all reasoning tasks on Qwen3-8B.
sentences.zh: 特别地，在 Qwen3-8B 上，ASAG 在所有推理任务中实现了 4.4% 的相对准确率提升，同时将生成词元数量减少了 40% 以上。

title_en: STORM: Segment, Track, and Object Re-Localization from a Single Image
title_zh: STORM：从单张图像进行分割、跟踪与物体重定位

sentences.en: Accurate 6D pose estimation and tracking are core capabilities for physical AI systems, yet real-world deployment remains brittle and labor-intensive.
sentences.zh: 精确的 6D 姿态估计与跟踪是物理 AI 系统的核心能力，然而真实世界的部署仍然脆弱且劳动密集。

sentences.en: Many pipelines rely on CAD models, manual masking, or per-object adaptation, and still fail under occlusion or fast motion without a principled way to recognize failure.
sentences.zh: 许多流水线依赖 CAD 模型、人工掩蔽或逐物体适配，并且在遮挡或快速运动下仍然会失效，且缺乏识别失效的规范方法。

sentences.en: We propose STORM, a unified framework for reference-conditioned 6D tracking that can operate from a single reference image, with minimal manual input and improved robustness.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 STORM：一个用于参考条件化 6D 跟踪的统一框架，它只需一张参考图像即可运行，所需人工输入最少，并具有更高的鲁棒性。

sentences.en: STORM combines: (i) Hierarchical Spatial Fusion Attention (HSFA), a task-driven reference-query fusion architecture that supports both single-reference and multi-reference conditioning and can optionally use vision-language semantic conditioning to resolve instance ambiguities; and (ii) a BCE-trained tracking verifier whose continuous compatibility logit is used as an energy-like score to detect drift and trigger automatic re-initialization.
sentences.zh: STORM 结合了：(i) 分层空间融合注意力（Hierarchical Spatial Fusion Attention，HSFA）：一种任务驱动的参考-查询融合架构，同时支持单参考与多参考条件化，并可选用视觉-语言语义条件化来解决实例歧义；(ii) 一个以 BCE 训练的跟踪验证器，其连续的兼容性 logit 被用作类似能量的分数来检测漂移并触发自动重新初始化。

sentences.en: Experiments on LM-O and YCB-Video show that STORM improves annotation-free pose tracking accuracy over strong baselines and recovers reliably from severe occlusions and rapid viewpoint changes with minimal overhead.
sentences.zh: 在 LM-O 与 YCB-Video 上的实验表明，STORM 在无关标注姿态跟踪准确率上优于强基线，并能在轻微开销下从严重遮挡与快速视角变化中可靠恢复。

title_en: StormInsight: Hierarchical Environmental Forcing and Vertical Coupling for Weather System Evolution
title_zh: StormInsight：面向天气系统演化的分层环境强迫与垂直耦合

sentences.en: Nowcasting forms the first line of defense against rapidly evolving weather hazards, where even minutes of delay can lead to severe societal impacts.
sentences.zh: 临近预报（nowcasting）构成了抵御快速演化的天气灾害的第一道防线，即使几分钟的延迟也可能导致严重的社会影响。

sentences.en: However, existing systems predominantly extrapolate 2D radar reflectivity, which struggles under rapid intensification regimes.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有系统主要外推 2D 雷达反射率，这在快速增强的情形下表现不佳。

sentences.en: We introduce StormInsight, a multi-scale modeling framework that enables coherent reconstruction of the three-dimensional evolution of convective systems while explicitly conditioning on the ambient environment.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了 StormInsight：一个多尺度建模框架，它能够在显式以周围环境为条件的同时，连贯地重建对流系统的三维演化。

sentences.en: StormInsight integrates multi-source observations—including radar, satellite, and station—with reanalysis fields through two components: (i) Storm Evolution Encoder that explicitly disentangles convective system state form vertical thermodynamic coupling and large-scale environmental forcing;
sentences.zh: StormInsight 通过两个组件将多源观测（包括雷达、卫星与地面站）与再分析场整合起来：(i) 风暴演化编码器（Storm Evolution Encoder），它将对流系统状态从垂直热动力耦合与大规模环境强迫中显式解离；

sentences.en: (ii) Convective System Decoder that predicts future echos by adaptively aggregating cross-layer interactions conditioned on evolving environmental conditions.
sentences.zh: (ii) 对流系统解码器（Convective System Decoder），它通过以演化的环境条件为条件、自适应地聚合跨层交互来预测未来的回波。

sentences.en: To support comprehensive evaluation, we build a new benchmark StormBench that integrates observational and reanalysis data across regions.
sentences.zh: 为支持全面评估，我们构建了新的基准 StormBench，它整合了跨区域的观测数据与再分析数据。

sentences.en: On this benchmark, StormInsight consistently achieves the best performance, reducing MAE by 12.4% and improving the mCSI by 34.0%.
sentences.zh: 在该基准上，StormInsight 始终取得最佳性能，将 MAE 降低了 12.4%，并将 mCSI 提升了 34.0%。

title_en: Strat-Reasoner: Reinforcing Strategic Reasoning of LLMs in Multi-Agent Games
title_zh: Strat-Reasoner：强化 LLM 在多智能体游戏中的策略推理

sentences.en: While Large Language Models (LLMs) excel in certain reasoning tasks, they struggle in multi-agent games where the final outcome depends on the joint strategies of all agents.
sentences.zh: 尽管大语言模型（LLM）在某些推理任务上表现出色，但在最终结果取决于所有智能体联合策略的多智能体游戏中，它们却举步维艰。

sentences.en: In multi-agent games, the non-stationarity of other agents brings significant challenges on the evaluation of the reasoning process and the credit assignment over multiple reasoning steps.
sentences.zh: 在多智能体游戏中，其他智能体的非平稳性给推理过程的评估以及跨多个推理步骤的信用分配带来了重大挑战。

sentences.en: Existing single-agent reinforcement learning (RL) approaches and their multi-agent extensions fail to address these challenges as they do not incorporate other agents in the reasoning process.
sentences.zh: 现有的单智能体强化学习（RL）方法及其多智能体扩展无法解决这些挑战，因为它们没有在推理过程中纳入其他智能体。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose Strat-Reasoner, a novel RL-based framework that improves LLMs' strategic reasoning ability in multi-agent games.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了 Strat-Reasoner：一个新颖的基于 RL 的框架，它提升了 LLM 在多智能体游戏中的策略推理能力。

sentences.en: We introduce a novel recursive reasoning paradigm where an agent's reasoning also integrates other agents' reasoning processes.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了一种新颖的递归推理范式，其中智能体的推理也会整合其他智能体的推理过程。

sentences.en: To provide effective reward signals for the intermediate reasoning sequences, we employ a centralized Chain-of-Thought (CoT) comparison module to evaluate the reasoning quality.
sentences.zh: 为向中间推理序列提供有效的奖励信号，我们采用一个集中式的思维链（CoT）比较模块来评估推理质量。

sentences.en: Finally, we compute an accurate hybrid advantage and develop a group-relative RL approach to optimize the LLM policy.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们计算精确的混合优势，并开发一种组相对 RL 方法来优化 LLM 策略。

sentences.en: Experimental results show that Strat-Reasoner substantially improves strategic abilities of underlying LLMs, achieving 22.1\% average performance improvements across various multi-agent games.
sentences.zh: 实验结果表明，Strat-Reasoner 大幅提升了底层 LLM 的策略能力，在各种多智能体游戏上实现了平均 22.1\% 的性能提升。

sentences.en: Code is publicly available at https://github.com/ydhe1012/Strat-Reasoner.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/ydhe1012/Strat-Reasoner 公开获取。

title_en: Strategic Candidacy in Generative AI Arenas
title_zh: 生成式 AI 竞技场中的策略性候选

sentences.en: AI arenas, which rank generative models from pairwise preferences of users, are a popular method for measuring the relative performance of models in the course of their organic use.
sentences.zh: AI 竞技场根据用户的两两偏好对生成模型进行排名，是在有机使用过程中衡量模型相对性能的一种流行方法。

sentences.en: Because rankings are computed from noisy preferences, there is a concern that model producers can exploit this randomness by submitting many models (e.g., multiple variants of essentially the same model) and thereby artificially improve the rank of their top models.
sentences.zh: 由于排名是从带噪偏好计算得出的，人们担心模型生产者可以利用这种随机性提交大量模型（例如同一模型实质上的多个变体），从而人为地提升其顶尖模型的排名。

sentences.en: This can lead to degradations in the quality, and therefore the usefulness, of the ranking.
sentences.zh: 这可能导致排名质量（进而其有用性）下降。

sentences.en: In this paper, we begin by establishing, both theoretically and in simulations calibrated to data from the platform Arena (formerly LMArena, Chatbot Arena), conditions under which producers can benefit from submitting clones when their goal is to be ranked highly.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们首先在理论上以及在与平台 Arena（原 LMArena、Chatbot Arena）数据校准的模拟中，确立了生产者以高排名为目标时可以通过提交克隆获益的条件。

sentences.en: We then propose a new mechanism for ranking models from pairwise comparisons, called You-Rank-We-Rank (YRWR).
sentences.zh: 随后，我们提出了一种从两两比较中对模型进行排名的新机制，称为 You-Rank-We-Rank（YRWR）。

sentences.en: It requires that producers submit rankings over their own models and uses these rankings to correct statistical estimates of model quality.
sentences.zh: 它要求生产者提交其自身模型的排名，并利用这些排名来校正模型质量的统计估计。

sentences.en: We prove that this mecha-nism is approximately clone-robust, in the sense that a producer cannot improve their rank much by doing anything other than submitting each of their unique models exactly once.
sentences.zh: 我们证明该机制近似地对克隆具有鲁棒性，即生产者除了将每个独特模型恰好提交一次之外，无法通过任何其他手段显著提升其排名。

sentences.en: Moreover, to the extent that model producers are able to correctly rank their own models, YRWR improves overall ranking accuracy.
sentences.zh: 此外，只要模型生产者能够正确地对自身模型进行排序，YRWR 就能提升整体排名准确率。

sentences.en: In further simulations, we show that indeed the mechanism is approximately clone-robust and quantify improvements to ranking accuracy, even under producer mis-ranking.
sentences.zh: 在进一步的模拟中，我们表明该机制确实近似地对克隆具有鲁棒性，并量化了即使在生产者错误排序的情况下排名准确率的提升。

title_en: Strategic Navigation or Stochastic Search? How Agents and Humans Reason Over Document Collections
title_zh: 策略性导航还是随机搜索？智能体与人类如何在文档集合上进行推理

sentences.en: Multimodal agents offer a compelling path to automating complex document-intensive workflows, yet a critical question remains: do these architectures demonstrate genuine strategic reasoning, or simply conduct stochastic trial-and-error search?
sentences.zh: 多模态智能体为自动化复杂的文档密集型工作流提供了一条引人瞩目的路径，但仍有一个关键问题：这些架构是展现了真正的策略性推理，还是仅仅进行随机试错搜索？

sentences.en: To address this, we introduce Agentic Document VQA, a benchmark of 2,250 human-authored questions grounded in 800 heterogeneous PDF documents.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们引入了 Agentic Document VQA：一个包含 2,250 个由人类撰写的、基于 800 份异构 PDF 文档的问题的基准。

sentences.en: Guided by *Classical Test Theory*, we design it to maximize discriminative power and reliably differentiate between varying levels of agent capability.
sentences.zh: 在*经典测量理论*（Classical Test Theory）的指导下，我们将其设计为最大化区分力，并可靠地区分不同水平的智能体能力。

sentences.en: To rigorously assess agentic behaviour, we introduce a novel evaluation protocol for measuring the accuracy-effort trade-off.
sentences.zh: 为严格评估智能体行为，我们引入了一种衡量准确率-努力权衡的新颖评估协议。

sentences.en: Using this framework, we find that humans show strong metacognitive calibration, adapting or abandoning failed strategies, whereas frontier agents often persist in unproductive loops with diminishing returns.
sentences.zh: 利用这一框架，我们发现人类表现出强大的元认知校准能力，会调整或放弃失败的策略，而前沿智能体往往在收益递减的无效循环中持续徘徊。

sentences.en: We release the dataset, evaluation harness, and leaderboard to help facilitate the transition from brute-force retrieval to calibrated, efficient reasoning.
sentences.zh: 我们发布了数据集、评估工具与排行榜，以帮助促进从暴力检索向经过校准的高效推理过渡。

title_en: Strategy Executability in Mathematical Reasoning: Leveraging Human–Model Differences for Effective Guidance
title_zh: 数学推理中的策略可执行性：利用人类与模型的差异实现有效引导

sentences.en: Example-based guidance is widely used to improve mathematical reasoning at inference time, yet its effectiveness is highly unstable across problems and models—even when the guidance is correct and problem-relevant.
sentences.zh: 基于示例的引导被广泛用于在推理时提升数学推理能力，然而即使引导正确且与问题相关，其有效性在不同问题与模型之间也极不稳定。

sentences.en: We show that this instability arises from a previously underexplored gap between *strategy usage*—whether a reasoning strategy appears in successful solutions—and *strategy executability*—whether the strategy remains effective when instantiated as guidance for a target model.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，这种不稳定性源于*策略使用*（strategy usage）——某个推理策略是否出现在成功解中——与*策略可执行性*（strategy executability）——该策略在被实例化为目标模型的引导时是否仍然有效——之间一个此前被充分忽视的差距。

sentences.en: Through a controlled analysis of paired human-written and model-generated solutions, we identify a systematic dissociation between usage and executability: human- and model-derived strategies differ in structured, domain-dependent ways, leading to complementary strengths and consistent source-dependent reversals under guidance.
sentences.zh: 通过对成对的人类撰写与模型生成的解进行受控分析，我们识别出使用与可执行性之间的系统性分离：源自人类与源自模型的策略以结构化、依赖领域的方式存在差异，从而在引导下产生互补的优势与一致的、依赖来源的逆转。

sentences.en: Building on this diagnosis, we propose *Selective Strategy Retrieval* (SSR), a test-time framework that explicitly models executability by selectively retrieving and combining strategies using empirical, multi-route, source-aware signals.
sentences.zh: 基于这一诊断，我们提出了*选择性策略检索*（Selective Strategy Retrieval，SSR）：一个测试时框架，它通过使用经验性、多路径、来源感知的信号选择性地检索并组合策略，对可执行性进行显式建模。

sentences.en: Across multiple mathematical reasoning benchmarks, SSR yields reliable and consistent improvements over direct solving, in-context learning, and single-source guidance, improving accuracy by up to $+13$ points on AIME25 and $+5$ points on Apex for compact reasoning models.
sentences.zh: 在多个数学推理基准上，SSR 比直接求解、上下文学习与单来源引导取得了可靠且一致的改进，对于紧凑推理模型，在 AIME25 上准确率提升了最多 $+13$ 分，在 Apex 上提升了 $+5$ 分。

sentences.en: Code and benchmark are publicly available at: https://github.com/lwd17/strategy-execute-pipeline.
sentences.zh: 代码与基准可在 https://github.com/lwd17/strategy-execute-pipeline 公开获取。

title_en: Strategy-Aware Optimization Modeling with Reasoning LLMs
title_zh: 使用推理 LLM 的策略感知优化建模

sentences.en: Large language models (LLMs) can generate syntactically valid optimization programs, yet often struggle to reliably choose an effective modeling strategy, leading to incorrect formulations and inefficient solver behavior.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）能够生成语法有效的优化程序，但往往难以可靠地选择有效的建模策略，从而导致错误的公式化与低效的求解器行为。

sentences.en: We propose **SAGE**, a strategy-aware framework that makes *Modeling Strategy* explicit in both data construction and post-training.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 **SAGE**：一个策略感知框架，它在数据构建与后训练中都使*建模策略*（Modeling Strategy）显式化。

sentences.en: SAGE builds a solver-verified multi-strategy dataset and trains a student model with supervised fine-tuning followed by Segment-Weighted GRPO using a composite reward over format compliance, correctness, and solver efficiency.
sentences.zh: SAGE 构建了一个经求解器验证的多策略数据集，并训练一个学生模型，该训练采用监督微调后进行段加权 GRPO，使用涵盖格式合规性、正确性与求解器效率的复合奖励。

sentences.en: Across eight benchmarks spanning synthetic and real-world settings, SAGE improves average pass@1 from 72.7 to 80.3 over the strongest open-source baseline.
sentences.zh: 在跨越合成与真实世界设置的八个基准上，与最强开源基线相比，SAGE 将平均 pass@1 从 72.7 提升到 80.3。

sentences.en: With multiple generations, SAGE discovers more distinct correct formulations and improves component-level diversity at pass@16 by 19-29%.
sentences.zh: 通过多次生成，SAGE 发现了更多不同的正确公式化，并在 pass@16 上将组件级多样性提升了 19-29%。

sentences.en: At the largest scale, SAGE produces more compact constraint systems with 14.2% fewer constraints than the baseline, consistent with solver-efficient modeling.
sentences.zh: 在最大规模上，SAGE 生成的约束系统更紧凑，约束数量比基线少 14.2%，这与求解器高效建模相一致。

sentences.en: Overall, these results show that making *Modeling Strategy* explicit improves automated optimization modeling.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，这些结果表明，使*建模策略*显式化能够改进自动化优化建模。

sentences.en: The code and data are available at https://github.com/rachhhhing/SAGE.
sentences.zh: 代码与数据可在 https://github.com/rachhhhing/SAGE 获取。

title_en: Stratified GRPO: Handling Structural Heterogeneity in Reinforcement Learning of LLM Search Agents
title_zh: 分层 GRPO：处理 LLM 搜索智能体强化学习中的结构异质性

sentences.en: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on external tools such as search engines to solve complex, multi-step problems, yet their rollouts are structurally heterogeneous: variations in tool-call number, placement, and outcomes induce distinct behaviors and reward distributions.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越依赖搜索引擎等外部工具来解决复杂的多步骤问题，然而它们的展开在结构上是异质的：工具调用数量、位置与结果的变化会引发不同的行为与奖励分布。

sentences.en: As a result, policy gradient methods with a single global baseline suffer from *cross-stratum bias*, an "apples-to-oranges'' comparison that distorts credit assignment and impedes exploration.
sentences.zh: 因此，使用单一全局基线的策略梯度方法会受到*跨层偏置*（cross-stratum bias）的影响，这是一种“苹果与橘子”式的比较，会扭曲信用分配并阻碍探索。

sentences.en: To address this issue, we propose *Stratified GRPO*.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了*分层 GRPO*（Stratified GRPO）。

sentences.en: Its core component, *Stratified Advantage Normalization* (SAN), partitions trajectories into homogeneous strata based on structural properties and computes advantages locally within each stratum, ensuring comparisons only among true peers.
sentences.zh: 其核心组件*分层优势归一化*（Stratified Advantage Normalization，SAN）根据结构属性将轨迹划分为同质的层，并在每层内部局部计算优势，确保仅在真正对等的样本之间进行比较。

sentences.en: We show that SAN eliminates cross-stratum bias, yields conditionally unbiased unit-variance estimates within strata, and preserves the global unbiasedness and unit-variance properties of standard normalization, resulting in a more reliable learning signal.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，SAN 消除了跨层偏置，在层内提供条件无偏的单位方差估计，并保留了标准归一化的全局无偏性与单位方差性质，从而产生更可靠的学习信号。

sentences.en: To improve robustness in finite-sample regimes, we further linearly blend SAN with the global estimator.
sentences.zh: 为提升有限样本情况下的鲁棒性，我们进一步将 SAN 与全局估计器进行线性混合。

sentences.en: Experiments on factual QA and deep-research agent benchmarks demonstrate that Stratified GRPO consistently outperforms GRPO by up to 12.6 points, achieving higher training rewards, improved training stability, and more effective search policies.
sentences.zh: 在事实问答与深度研究智能体基准上的实验表明，分层 GRPO 始终以最高 12.6 分的优势优于 GRPO，实现了更高的训练奖励、更好的训练稳定性与更有效的搜索策略。

sentences.en: These results establish structure-aware advantage normalization as an effective correction for RL of search agents with structurally heterogeneous rollouts.
sentences.zh: 这些结果表明，结构感知的优势归一化是对具有结构异质展开的搜索智能体进行 RL 的有效校正手段。

title_en: Stream RAG: Instant and Accurate Spoken Dialogue Systems with Streaming Tool Usage
title_zh: Stream RAG：带流式工具使用的即时且准确的语音对话系统

sentences.en: End-to-end speech-in, speech-out dialogue systems are emerging as a powerful alternative to traditional ASR–LLM–TTS pipelines but remain prone to hallucinations due to limited factual grounding.
sentences.zh: 端到端的语音输入-语音输出对话系统正在成为传统 ASR-LLM-TTS 流水线的强大替代方案，但由于事实依据有限，它们仍然容易产生幻觉。

sentences.en: While text-based dialogue models have effectively mitigated this issue through tools such as web search APIs, extending such capabilities to speech-in, speech-out systems remains underexplored.
sentences.zh: 虽然基于文本的对话模型已通过网络搜索 API 等工具有效缓解了这一问题，但将此类能力扩展到语音输入-语音输出系统仍未得到充分探索。

sentences.en: A key challenge is that tool integration increases latency, disrupting conversational flow.
sentences.zh: 一个关键挑战是工具集成会增加延迟，破坏对话的流畅性。

sentences.en: To mitigate this, we propose Streaming Retrieval-Augmented Generation (Stream RAG), a novel framework that reduces latency by predicting tool queries in parallel with user speech, even before the user finishes speaking.
sentences.zh: 为缓解这一问题，我们提出了流式检索增强生成（Streaming Retrieval-Augmented Generation，Stream RAG）：一个新颖的框架，它通过并行预测工具查询（甚至在用户说完之前）来降低延迟。

sentences.en: Specifically, we develop a post-training pipeline that teaches the model when to issue tool calls and how to generate spoken summaries using retrieved text results, thereby improving both accuracy and responsiveness.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们开发了一个后训练流水线，教会模型何时发起工具调用以及如何利用检索到的文本结果生成语音摘要，从而同时提升准确率与响应速度。

sentences.en: To evaluate our approach, we construct AudioCRAG, a benchmark created by converting queries from the publicly available CRAG dataset into speech form.
sentences.zh: 为评估我们的方法，我们构建了 AudioCRAG：一个将公开 CRAG 数据集的查询转换为语音形式而创建的基准。

sentences.en: Experimental results show that Stream RAG improves QA accuracy by over 20.0% absolute on AudioCRAG and achieves state-of-the-art performance, including outperforming cascaded systems, on the SLUE-SQA benchmark, while reducing latency by up to 57%.
sentences.zh: 实验结果表明，Stream RAG 在 AudioCRAG 上将问答准确率提升了超过 20.0 个百分点，并在 SLUE-SQA 基准上取得了最先进的性能（包括超越级联系统），同时将延迟降低了最多 57%。

sentences.en: Stream RAG is modality-agnostic and can be applied equally to typed input, paving the way for more agentic, real-time AI assistants.
sentences.zh: Stream RAG 与模态无关，同样适用于键入输入，为更具智能体性的实时 AI 助手铺平了道路。

title_en: StreamFlow: Theory, Algorithm, and Implementation for High-Efficiency Rectified Flow Generation
title_zh: StreamFlow：高效校正流生成的理论、算法与实现

sentences.en: New technologies such as Rectified Flow and Flow Matching have significantly improved the performance of generative models in the past two years, especially in terms of control accuracy, generation quality, and generation efficiency.
sentences.zh: 在过去两年中，校正流（Rectified Flow）与流匹配（Flow Matching）等新技术显著提升了生成模型的性能，尤其是在控制精度、生成质量与生成效率方面。

sentences.en: However, due to some differences in its theory, design, and existing diffusion models, the existing acceleration methods cannot be directly applied to the Rectified Flow model.
sentences.zh: 然而，由于校正流在理论、设计上与现有扩散模型存在一些差异，现有加速方法无法直接应用于校正流模型。

sentences.en: In this article, we have comprehensively implemented an overall acceleration pipeline from the aspects of theory, design, and reasoning strategies.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们从理论、设计与推理策略三个方面综合实现了一条整体的加速流水线。

sentences.en: This pipeline uses new methods such as batch processing with a new velocity field, vectorization of heterogeneous time-step batch processing, and dynamic TensorRT compilation for the new methods to comprehensively accelerate related models based on flow models.
sentences.zh: 该流水线使用诸如采用新速度场的批处理、异构时间步批处理的向量化、以及针对新方法的动态 TensorRT 编译等新方法，全面加速基于流模型的相关模型。

sentences.en: Currently, the existing public methods usually achieve an acceleration of 18%, while experiments have proved that our new method can accelerate the 512$\times$512 image generation speed to up to 611%, which is far beyond the current non-generalized acceleration methods.
sentences.zh: 目前，现有的公开方法通常只能实现 18% 的加速，而实验证明我们的新方法可以将 512$\times$512 图像的生成速度提升到最多 611%，远远超出当前非泛化的加速方法。

sentences.en: Project page at [https://world-snapshot.github.io/StreamFlow/](https://world-snapshot.github.io/StreamFlow/).
sentences.zh: 项目主页见 https://world-snapshot.github.io/StreamFlow/。

title_en: Streaming Covariate Balancing via Discrepancy-Based Feature Coresets
title_zh: 基于差异的特征核心集的流式协变量平衡

sentences.en: Real-time estimation of average treatment effects (ATE) in streaming observational data poses two key challenges: strict memory constraints that preclude storing the full data history, and distributional shifts in both treatment assignment and outcome-generating process.
sentences.zh: 在流式观测数据中实时估计平均处理效应（ATE）面临两个关键挑战：严格的内存约束使得无法存储完整的数据历史，以及处理分配与结果生成过程两方面的分布漂移。

sentences.en: Existing methods either require offline access to the entire dataset for covariate balancing or rely on parametric online models that are vulnerable to model misspecification under such shifts.
sentences.zh: 现有方法要么需要离线访问整个数据集以进行协变量平衡，要么依赖在此类漂移下容易受模型设定错误影响的（model misspecification）参数化在线模型。

sentences.en: This paper proposes a novel model-agnostic method for ATE estimation in streaming data, which effectively addresses the above challenges.
sentences.zh: 本文提出了一种新颖的、与模型无关的流式数据 ATE 估计方法，它有效解决了上述挑战。

sentences.en: Based on discrepancy theory, we first compress streaming data into feature coresets that preserve covariate balancing objectives over a rich nonparametric function class, enabling linear-time updates with bounded memory.
sentences.zh: 基于差异理论，我们首凳将流式数据压缩为特征核心集，在丰富的非参数函数类上保持协变量平衡目标，从而以有界内存实现线性时间更新。

sentences.en: Then, by directly learning balancing weights and bypassing parametric propensity score estimation, we enhance the model's robustness against the shift in treatment assignment, while by balancing over an expressive function space we make the model more adaptive to the shift in the outcome-generating process.
sentences.zh: 随后，通过直接学习平衡权重并绕过参数化倾向得分估计，我们增强了模型对处理分配漂移的鲁棒性；同时通过在一个富有表现力的函数空间上进行平衡，使模型对结果生成过程的漂移更具适应性。

sentences.en: Theoretically, we establish convergence guarantees with explicit bounds on memory usage and computational complexity.
sentences.zh: 在理论上，我们建立了收敛保证，并给出内存使用与计算复杂度的显式界。

sentences.en: Empirically, extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets show the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed method, consistently outperforming existing techniques.
sentences.zh: 在实证上，在合成与真实世界数据集上的大量实验表明，所提出的方法有效且稳健，始终优于现有技术。

authors.name: Hao Zhang
authors.institution: Shenzhen Institutes of Advanced Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences

title_en: Streaming Sliced Optimal Transport
title_zh: 流式切片最优传输

sentences.en: Sliced optimal transport (SOT), or sliced Wasserstein (SW) distance, is widely recognized for its statistical and computational scalability.
sentences.zh: 切片最优传输（Sliced Optimal Transport，SOT），又称切片 Wasserstein（SW）距离，因其统计与计算上的可扩展性而广受认可。

sentences.en: In this work, we further enhance computational scalability by proposing the first method for estimating SW from sample streams, called streaming sliced Wasserstein (Stream-SW).
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们通过提出首个从样本流估计 SW 的方法（流式切片 Wasserstein，Stream-SW）进一步增强了计算可扩展性。

sentences.en: To define Stream-SW, we first introduce a streaming estimator of the one-dimensional Wasserstein distance (1DW).
sentences.zh: 为定义 Stream-SW，我们首先引入一维 Wasserstein 距离（1DW）的流式估计器。

sentences.en: Since the 1DW has a closed-form expression, given by the integral of the absolute difference between the quantile functions of the compared distributions, we leverage quantile approximation techniques for sample streams to define a streaming 1DW estimator.
sentences.zh: 由于 1DW 具有闭式表达式，即被比较分布的分位数函数之差的绝对值积分，我们利用样本流的分位数近似技术来定义流式 1DW 估计器。

sentences.en: By applying the streaming 1DW to all projections, we obtain Stream-SW.
sentences.zh: 通过将流式 1DW 应用于所有投影，我们得到 Stream-SW。

sentences.en: The key advantage of Stream-SW is its low memory complexity while providing theoretical guarantees on the approximation error.
sentences.zh: Stream-SW 的关键优势在于其低内存复杂度，同时对近似误差提供理论保证。

sentences.en: We demonstrate that Stream-SW achieves a more accurate approximation of SW than random subsampling, with lower memory consumption, when comparing Gaussian distributions and mixtures of Gaussians from streaming samples.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，在比较来自流式样本的高斯分布与高斯混合时，与随机子采样相比，Stream-SW 以更低的内存消耗实现了对 SW 更精确的近似。

sentences.en: Additionally, we conduct experiments on point cloud classification, point cloud gradient flows, and streaming change point detection to further highlight the favorable performance of the proposed Stream-SW.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们在点云分类、点云梯度流与流式变点检测上进行实验，以进一步凸显所提出的 Stream-SW 的优越性能。

title_en: StretchTime: Adaptive Time Series Forecasting via Symplectic Attention
title_zh: StretchTime：通过辛注意力实现自适应时间序列预测

sentences.en: Transformer architectures have established strong baselines in time series forecasting, yet they typically rely on positional encodings that assume uniform, index-based temporal progression.
sentences.zh: Transformer 架构已在时间序列预测中确立了强大的基线，然而它们通常依赖假设均匀、基于索引的时间推进的位置编码。

sentences.en: However, real-world systems, from shifting financial cycles to elastic biological rhythms, frequently exhibit ``time-warped'' dynamics where the effective flow of time decouples from the sampling index.
sentences.zh: 然而，从变化的金融周期到弹性的生物节律，现实世界的系统常常表现出“时间扭曲”动力学，其中时间的有效流动与采样索引脱钩。

sentences.en: In this work, we first formalize this misalignment and prove that rotary position embedding (RoPE) is mathematically incapable of representing non-affine temporal warping.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们首先将这种错位形式化，并证明旋转位置嵌入（RoPE）在数学上无法表示非仿射的时间扭曲。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose Symplectic Positional Embeddings (SyPE), a learnable encoding framework derived from Hamiltonian mechanics.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了辛位置嵌入（Symplectic Positional Embeddings，SyPE）：一个源自哈密顿力学的可学习编码框架。

sentences.en: SyPE strictly generalizes RoPE by extending the rotation group $\mathrm{SO}(2)$ to the symplectic group $\mathrm{Sp}(2,\mathbb{R})$, modulated by a novel input-dependent adaptive warp module.
sentences.zh: SyPE 通过将旋转群 $\mathrm{SO}(2)$ 扩展到辛群 $\mathrm{Sp}(2,\mathbb{R})$，并以新颖的输入依赖自适应扭曲模块进行调制，从而严格泛化了 RoPE。

sentences.en: By allowing the attention mechanism to adaptively dilate or contract temporal coordinates end-to-end, our approach captures locally varying periodicities without requiring pre-defined warping functions.
sentences.zh: 通过让注意力机制在端到端过程中自适应地扩张或收缩时间坐标，我们的方法能够捕捉局部变化的周期性，而无需预先定义的扭曲函数。

sentences.en: We implement this mechanism in StretchTime, a multivariate forecasting architecture that achieves state-of-the-art performance on standard benchmarks, demonstrating superior robustness on datasets exhibiting non-stationary temporal dynamics.
sentences.zh: 我们将该机制实现于 StretchTime：一个多变量预测架构，它在标准基准上取得了最先进的性能，并在表现出非平稳时间动力学的数据集上展现了卓越的鲁棒性。

title_en: STRIDE: Post-Training LLMs to Reason and Refine Bio-Sequences via Edit Trajectories
title_zh: STRIDE：通过编辑轨迹对 LLM 进行后训练以推理并精化生物序列

sentences.en: Discrete biological sequence optimization often requires goal-directed, parser-valid edits to an existing protein or molecule.
sentences.zh: 离散的生物序列优化常常需要对现有蛋白质或分子进行目标导向的、解析器有效的编辑。

sentences.en: Diffusion models support iterative refinement but do not   expose a controllable discrete-edit interface, while autoregressive LLMs can be myopic when planning constrained edits over multiple steps.
sentences.zh: 扩散模型支持迭代精化，但不提供可控的离散编辑接口，而自回归 LLM 在规划跨多个步骤的受限编辑时可能显得目光短浅。

sentences.en: We introduce *STRIDE* (Sequence Trajectory   Refinement via Iterative Discrete Editing), a post-training framework that trains an LLM to emit executable INSERT/DELETE/REPLACE trajectories for variable-length refinement.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了 *STRIDE*（Sequence Trajectory Refinement via Iterative Discrete Editing，通过迭代离散编辑的序列轨迹精化）：一个后训练框架，它训练 LLM 为变长精化生成可执行的插入/删除/替换轨迹。

sentences.en: *STRIDE*   first learns Levenshtein-aligned shortest-edit demonstrations, then uses supervised fine-tuning and group-based policy optimization to align trajectories with task rewards while   preserving coherent editing.
sentences.zh: *STRIDE* 首先学习 Levenshtein 对齐的最短编辑演示，然后使用监督微调与基于组的策略优化来使轨迹与任务奖励对齐，同时保持连贯的编辑。

sentences.en: On an oracle-based full-action protein stress test, *STRIDE* raises success over Vanilla SFT from 42% to 89% and novelty among unique improvements from 47%   to 97%.
sentences.zh: 在基于 oracle 的全动作蛋白质压力测试中，*STRIDE* 将成功率从普通 SFT 的 42% 提升到 89%，并将独特改进中的新颖性从 47% 提升到 97%。

sentences.en: On instruction-conditioned molecular editing, the GSPO-aligned variant improves strict success, controllability, and SMILES validity over the SFT-only *STRIDE* model (code:   https://github.com/daiheng-zhang/STRIDE).
sentences.zh: 在指令条件下的分子编辑中，GSPO 对齐的变体在严格成功率、可控性与 SMILES 有效性方面都优于仅 SFT 的 *STRIDE* 模型（代码：https://github.com/daiheng-zhang/STRIDE）。

title_en: Stronger Benchmarks for Prediction as a Service with Constraints
title_zh: 带约束的预测即服务：更强的基准

sentences.en: We study a learner who sequentially makes and broadcasts predictions of some underlying adversarially varying state.
sentences.zh: 我们研究一个学习器，它按顺序对某种对抗性变化的底层状态作出预测并进行广播。

sentences.en: Many downstream decision makers with different goals and different long-term constraints consume these decisions to choose actions.
sentences.zh: 许多具有不同目标与不同长期约束的下游决策者使用这些决策来选择动作。

sentences.en: In this setting we give the first algorithm that obtains simultaneous *dynamic regret* guarantees for all of the decision makers --- where regret for each agent is measured against a potentially changing sequence of actions across rounds of interaction, while also ensuring vanishing constraint violation for each agent.
sentences.zh: 在此设置下，我们给出了第一个为所有决策者同时获得*动态遗憾*保证的算法：其中每个智能体的遗憾是针对跨交互轮次的、可能变化的动作序列来衡量的，同时确保每个智能体的约束违反趋于零。

sentences.en: We can promise these dynamic regret bounds not just marginally, but simultaneously on many different intersecting subsequences, which lets decision makers compete with strategies that adapt with both long-term drift and short-term variation.
sentences.zh: 我们不仅能逐一地承诺这些动态遗憾界，还能在许多不同的相交子序列上同时承诺，这使决策者能够与同时适应长期漂移与短期变化的策略竞争。

sentences.en: Our results do not require the decision makers to maintain any state, but just to react myopically to our predictions.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果不要求决策者维护任何状态，只需对我们的预测作出短视的响应。

title_en: StructMamPose: From Sequential Perception to Structural Reasoning for 3D Human Pose Estimation
title_zh: StructMamPose：从序列感知到结构推理的 3D 人体姿态估计

sentences.en: Accurately modeling complex temporal and topological dependencies and depth information is critical for monocular 3D human pose estimation, yet existing Mamba-based approaches struggle to fulfill these demands, suffering from internal state update confusion induced by forced sequence flattening and depth modeling confusion inherent to single-view observations.
sentences.zh: 精确地对复杂的时间与拓扑依赖以及深度信息进行建模，对于单目 3D 人体姿态估计至关重要，然而现有的基于 Mamba 的方法难以满足这些需求，它们受困于强制序列展平所导致的状态更新混乱，以及单视角观测固有的深度建模混乱。

sentences.en: To address this confusion, we propose a StructMamPose framework equipped with Identity Anchoring Mechanism (IAM) and View Transformation Hub (VTH).
sentences.zh: 为应对这种混乱，我们提出了一个配备身份锚定机制（Identity Anchoring Mechanism，IAM）与视图变换中枢（View Transformation Hub，VTH）的 StructMamPose 框架。

sentences.en: The IAM injects spatiotemporal identities into the parameter generation network to anchor the selectivity of state update matrices, suppressing spurious connections to enforce feature propagation along valid topological dependencies.
sentences.zh: IAM 将时空身份注入参数生成网络，以锚定状态更新矩阵的选择性，抑制虚假连接，从而强制特征沿有效的拓扑依赖传播。

sentences.en: The VTH performs internal coordinate rotation to transform implicit depth inference into observable planar features, endowing the model with explicit spatial understanding and multi-view constraints.
sentences.zh: VTH 执行内部坐标旋转，将隐式深度推断转化为可观察的平面特征，赋予模型显式的空间理解与多视图约束。

sentences.en: Experimental results demonstrate that our framework achieves SOTA performance on most datasets.
sentences.zh: 实验结果表明，我们的框架在大多数数据集上取得了 SOTA 性能。

title_en: StructMAR: Structure-Aware Masked Autoregression for Explicit Layout Alignment in Text-to-Image Generation
title_zh: StructMAR：面向文生图中显式布局对齐的结构感知掩蔽自回归

sentences.en: Although text-to-image generation has achieved significant progress, strict instance-level layout alignment remains a challenge for many applications.
sentences.zh: 尽管文生图生成已取得显著进展，但严格的实例级布局对齐对许多应用而言仍然是一大挑战。

sentences.en: Masked Autoregressive (MAR) models on continuous latents are both efficient and high-fidelity, yet the standard practice of flattening 2D latents into 1D sequences weakens spatial topology, limiting precise controllability.
sentences.zh: 基于连续潜在表示的掩蔽自回归（Masked Autoregressive，MAR）模型既高效又高保真，然而将 2D 潜在表示展平为 1D 序列的标准做法会削弱空间拓扑，限制精确的可控性。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose StructMAR, a structure-aware masked autoregressive framework that transforms layout alignment from a soft correlation into an explicit structural alignment.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了 StructMAR：一个结构感知的掩蔽自回归框架，它将布局对齐从软相关转化为显式的结构对齐。

sentences.en: By integrating 2D Rotary Positional Embeddings with a Layout-Guided Attention Bias, StructMAR explicitly biases latent tokens toward their corresponding layout instances during attention computation.
sentences.zh: 通过将 2D 旋转位置嵌入与布局引导的注意力偏置相结合，StructMAR 在注意力计算期间显式地将潜在词元偏向其对应的布局实例。

sentences.en: We further use Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) as a final-stage policy refinement to reduce the mismatch between the MAR training objective and detector-based layout evaluation metrics.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步使用组相对策略优化（GRPO）作为收尾阶段的策略精化，以减少 MAR 训练目标与基于检测器的布局评估指标之间的不匹配。

sentences.en: Evaluated on the COCO-Position and COCO-MIG benchmarks, StructMAR achieves state-of-the-art performance, reaching 57.2 AP and 79.4 mIoU on the former, and 61.7 ISR and 56.9 mIoU on the latter.
sentences.zh: 在 COCO-Position 与 COCO-MIG 基准上的评估表明，StructMAR 取得了最先进的性能：在 COCO-Position 上达到 57.2 AP 与 79.4 mIoU，在 COCO-MIG 上达到 61.7 ISR 与 56.9 mIoU。

sentences.en: These results, coupled with a 4.05$\times$ inference speedup, underscore the efficacy of explicit structural inductive biases in controllable autoregressive generation.
sentences.zh: 这些结果，连同 4.05$\times$ 的推理加速，凸显了显式结构归纳偏置在可控自回归生成中的有效性。

authors.name: Junying Zhang
authors.institution: Xi'an University of Electronic Science and Technology

title_en: Structurally Aligned Subtask-Level Memory for Software Engineering Agents
title_zh: 面向软件工程智能体的结构对齐子任务级记忆

sentences.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated significant potential as autonomous software engineering (SWE) agents.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）已展现出作为自主软件工程（SWE）智能体的巨大潜力。

sentences.en: Recent work has further explored augmenting these agents with memory mechanisms to support long-horizon reasoning.
sentences.zh: 近期工作进一步探索了用记忆机制增强这些智能体，以支持长时程推理。

sentences.en: However, these approaches typically operate at a coarse instance granularity, treating the entire problem-solving episode as the atomic unit of storage and retrieval.
sentences.zh: 然而，这些方法通常以粗粒度的实例粒度运作，将整个问题求解过程视为存储与检索的原子单元。

sentences.en: We empirically demonstrate that instance-level memory suffers from a fundamental granularity mismatch, resulting in misguided retrieval when tasks with similar surface descriptions require distinct reasoning logic at specific stages.
sentences.zh: 我们实证表明，实例级记忆存在根本性的粒度不匹配，当表面描述相似的任务在特定阶段需要不同的推理逻辑时，会导致检索出现偏差。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose Structurally Aligned Subtask-Level Memory, a method that aligns memory storage, retrieval, and updating with the agent’s functional decomposition.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了结构对齐子任务级记忆（Structurally Aligned Subtask-Level Memory）：一种将记忆的存储、检索与更新同智能体的功能分解相对齐的方法。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on SWE-bench Verified demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms both vanilla agents and strong instance-level memory baselines across diverse backbones, improving mean Pass@1 over the vanilla agent by +4.7 pp on average (e.g., +6.8 pp on Gemini 2.5 Pro).
sentences.zh: 在 SWE-bench Verified 上的大量实验表明，我们的方法在多种骨干模型上始终优于普通智能体与强实例级记忆基线，与普通智能体相比，平均 Pass@1 平均提升了 +4.7 个百分点（例如在 Gemini 2.5 Pro 上提升 +6.8 个百分点）。

sentences.en: Performance gains grow with more interaction steps, showing that leveraging past experience benefits long-horizon reasoning in complex software engineering tasks.
sentences.zh: 性能增益随交互步骤的增多而增长，表明利用过去的经验有利于在复杂软件工程任务中进行长时程推理。

title_en: Structure Abstraction and Generalization in a Hippocampal-Entorhinal Inspired World Model
title_zh: 海马-内嗅区启发发的世界模型中的结构抽象与泛化

sentences.en: Humans abstract experiences into structured representations to facilitate pattern inference and knowledge transfer.
sentences.zh: 人类将经验抽象为结构化表示，以促进模式推断与知识迁移。

sentences.en: While the hippocampal-entorhinal (HPC-MEC) circuit is known to represent both spatial and conceptual spaces, the mechanisms for concurrently extracting abstract structures from continuous, high-dimensional dynamics remain poorly understood.
sentences.zh: 尽管海马-内嗅区（HPC-MEC）回路被认为同时表征空间与概念空间，但从连续、高维动力学中并行提取抽象结构的机制仍未得到充分理解。

sentences.en: We propose a brain-inspired hierarchical model that simultaneously infers latent transitions and constructs a predictive visual world model.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了一个受大脑启发的分层模型，它同时推断潜在转移并构建预测性的视觉世界模型。

sentences.en: Our architecture employs an inverse model for structural extraction alongside an HPC-MEC coupling model that dissociates relational structures (MEC) from integrated episodic scenes (HPC).
sentences.zh: 我们的架构采用一个用于结构提取的逆模型，以及一个 HPC-MEC 耦合模型，后者将关系结构（MEC）与整合的情节场景（HPC）分离开来。

sentences.en: Using rotation dynamics as a benchmark, we demonstrate the model's capacity for structural abstraction.
sentences.zh: 以旋转动力学为基准，我们展示了该模型的结构抽象能力。

sentences.en: By leveraging velocity-driven path integration, the framework enables robust prediction and structural reuse across diverse contexts, thereby achieving structural generalization.
sentences.zh: 通过利用速度驱动的路径整合，该框架能够在多种情境下实现稳健的预测与结构复用，从而实现结构泛化。

sentences.en: This work provides a novel computational framework for understanding how brain-inspired, self-supervised learning of world models facilitates the acquisition of reusable abstract knowledge.
sentences.zh: 这项工作为理解受大脑启发的世界模型自监督学习如何促进可复用抽象知识的获取提供了一个新颖的计算框架。

title_en: Structure Enables Effective Self-Localization of Errors in LLMs
title_zh: 结构使 LLM 能够有效地对误差进行自我定位

sentences.en: Self-correction in language models remains elusive.
sentences.zh: 语言模型中的自我纠错仍然难以实现。

sentences.en: In this work, we explore whether language models can explicitly localize errors in incorrect reasoning, as a path toward building AI systems that can effectively correct themselves.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们探索语言模型能否显式地定位错误推理中的误差，作为构建能够有效自我修正的 AI 系统的一条路径。

sentences.en: We introduce a prompting method that structures reasoning as discrete, semantically coherent thought steps, and show that models can localize errors more reliably within this structure than in conventional, unstructured chain-of-thought reasoning.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了一种将推理结构化为离散、语义连贯思维步骤的提示方法，并表明模型在此结构中比在传统、无结构的思维链推理中能更可靠地定位误差。

sentences.en: Motivated by how the human brain monitors errors at discrete decision points and resamples alternatives, we introduce Iterative Correction Sampling of Thoughts (Thought-ICS), a self-correction framework.
sentences.zh: 受人类大脑在离散决策点监测误差并重新采样备选方案的启发，我们引入了迭代思维纠错采样（Iterative Correction Sampling of Thoughts，Thought-ICS）：一个自我纠错框架。

sentences.en: Thought-ICS iteratively prompts the model to generate reasoning one discrete and complete thought at a time—where each thought represents a deliberate decision by the model—creating natural boundaries for precise error localization.
sentences.zh: Thought-ICS 迭代地提示模型一次生成一个离散且完整的思维：每个思维代表模型的一个深思熟虑的决策，从而为精确的误差定位创造出天然的边界。

sentences.en: Upon verification, the model localizes the first erroneous step, and the system backtracks to generate alternative reasoning from the last correct point.
sentences.zh: 在验证时，模型定位第一个错误步骤，系统回溯并从最后一个正确点生成替代推理。

sentences.en: When asked to correct reasoning verified as incorrect by an oracle, Thought-ICS achieves 20-40% self-correction lift.
sentences.zh: 当被要求修正经 oracle 验证为错误的推理时，Thought-ICS 实现了 20-40% 的自我纠错提升。

sentences.en: In a completely autonomous setting without external verification, it outperforms contemporary self-correction baselines.
sentences.zh: 在没有外部验证的完全自主设置中，它优于当代的自我纠错基线。

title_en: Structure-Aware Consistency Priors for Shape from Polarization in Complex Media
title_zh: 复杂介质中偏振形状恢复的结构感知一致性先验

sentences.en: Recovering surface normals from single-view polarization images in complex media remains challenging.
sentences.zh: 在复杂介质中从单视角偏振图像恢复表面法线仍然颇具挑战。

sentences.en: This paper focuses on ice as a representative complex medium, where intricate light–matter interactions lead to a nonlinear mapping between polarization observations and surface normals.
sentences.zh: 本文以冰作为代表性复杂介质，其中复杂的光-物质相互作用导致偏振观测与表面法线之间存在非线性映射。

sentences.en: To address this, a structure-aware polarization prior based on autocorrelation functions is proposed to capture the local spatial consistency of AoLP.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种基于自相关函数的结构感知偏振先验，以捕获 AoLP 的局部空间一致性。

sentences.en: Building on this, a dual-branch network (IceSfP) is designed to integrate raw polarization features with priors via cross-modal attention and multi-scale feature fusion, enabling accurate surface normal estimation under complex media conditions.
sentences.zh: 在此基础上，我们设计了一个双分支网络（IceSfP），通过跨模态注意力与多尺度特征融合将原始偏振特征与先验整合起来，从而在复杂介质条件下实现准确的表面法线估计。

sentences.en: To evaluate the method, the first real-world ice SfP dataset is constructed.
sentences.zh: 为评估该方法，我们构建了首个真实世界的冰 SfP 数据集。

sentences.en: Experimental results show that the method outperforms existing approaches across all metrics, achieving a MAE of 16.01$^\circ$, which is 2.74$^\circ$ lower than the second-best method.
sentences.zh: 实验结果表明，该方法在所有指标上都优于现有方法，MAE 达到 16.01$^\circ$，比次优方法低 2.74$^\circ$。

sentences.en: The framework provides a generalizable solution for high-precision geometric perception in complex media.
sentences.zh: 该框架为复杂介质中的高精度几何感知提供了一种可泛化的解决方案。
