title_en: Structure-aware Granular-Ball based Information Bottleneck for Multi-modal Clustering
title_zh: 基于结构感知粒度球信息瓶颈的多模态聚类

sentences.en: Multi-modal clustering, which integrates information from diverse sources and feature modalities, has shown great potential in data mining and computer vision.
sentences.zh: 多模态聚类整合来自不同来源与特征模态的信息，在数据挖掘与计算机视觉中展现出巨大潜力。

sentences.en: However, existing methods relying on single-granularity relationships often struggle with complex data distributions, leading to limited performance, as fine-grained features are prone to local heterogeneity and redundant perturbations while coarse-grained representations tend to lose local structural information.
sentences.zh: 然而，依赖单一粒度关系的现有方法往往难以处理复杂的数据分布，导致性能有限：细粒度特征易受局部异构性与冗余扰动的影响，而粗粒度表示则容易丢失局部结构信息。

sentences.en: To address these limitations, we introduce granular-balls (GBs), adaptive multi-granularity hyperspheres that enclose similar samples, and propose the Structure-aware Granular-Ball based Information Bottleneck (SGB-IB) algorithm.
sentences.zh: 为解决这些局限，我们引入了粒度球（Granular-Ball，GB）：包围相似样本的自适应多粒度超球体，并提出了基于结构感知粒度球的信息瓶颈（Structure-aware Granular-Ball based Information Bottleneck，SGB-IB）算法。

sentences.en: This method initializes the dataset as a single GB and recursively splits GBs based on a purity metric, which quantifies the average mutual information between sample features and K-means-derived pseudo-labels across all modalities.
sentences.zh: 该方法将数据集初始化为单个 GB，并基于纯度度量递归地分裂 GB，该纯度度量化了所有模态上样本特征与 K-means 派生的伪标签之间的平均互信息。

sentences.en: It also balances local structure preservation and global redundancy suppression through a structure-aware objective function.
sentences.zh: 它还通过结构感知的目标函数在局部结构保留与全局冗余抑制之间取得平衡。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that our method outperforms state-of-the-art approaches, validating the effectiveness of fusing GB structures with information-theoretic principles.
sentences.zh: 在基准数据集上的大量实验表明，我们的方法优于最先进的方法，验证了将 GB 结构与信息论原理相融合的有效性。

title_en: Structure-Aware Riemannian Flow Matching for Registration and Fusion of Hyperspectral and Multispectral Images
title_zh: 用于高光谱与多光谱图像配准与融合的结构感知黎曼流匹配

sentences.en: Precise alignment is a prerequisite for hyperspectral and multispectral image fusion, yet existing methods struggle with complex non-rigid deformations.
sentences.zh: 精确对齐是高光谱与多光谱图像融合的前提，然而现有方法难以处理复杂的非刚体变形。

sentences.en: Existing techniques either suffer from inter-task error accumulation by treating registration and fusion as disjoint processes or neglect the geometric nature of distortions by relying on isotropic Euclidean metrics.
sentences.zh: 现有技术要么将配准与融合视为不相干的过程而饱受任务间误差累积之苦，要么依赖各向同性欧几里得度量而忽视了畸变的几何本质。

sentences.en: We propose Structure-Aware Riemannian Flow Matching (SA-RFM), a geometry-informed framework for joint registration and fusion of hyperspectral and multispectral images.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了结构感知黎曼流匹配（Structure-Aware Riemannian Flow Matching，SA-RFM）：一个用于高光谱与多光谱图像联合配准与融合的、融入几何信息的框架。

sentences.en: SA-RFM reformulates registration as dynamic optimal transport on a structure-induced Riemannian manifold, where anisotropic costs are derived from MSI structural cues.
sentences.zh: SA-RFM 将配准重新表述为结构诱导黎曼流形上的动态最优传输，其中各向异性代价由 MSI 结构线索导出。

sentences.en: To circumvent the complexity of explicit OT solvers, we incorporate this geometry into a conditional flow matching framework via a local cost approximation.
sentences.zh: 为规避显式 OT 求解器的复杂性，我们通过局部代价近似将该几何结构融入条件流匹配框架。

sentences.en: This formulation is realized through two synergistic mechanisms: a Riemannian Flow Matching objective that enforces structure-aware error measurement, and an optimal transport direction regularization that aligns the velocity field with the induced metric, thereby resolving the fundamental mismatch between anisotropic costs and conventional Euclidean supervision.
sentences.zh: 这种形式通过两个协同机制实现：一个强制执行结构感知误差测量的黎曼流匹配目标，以及一个将速度场与诱导度量对齐的最优传输方向正则化，从而解决了各向异性代价与常规欧几里得监督之间的根本性不匹配。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on four datasets demonstrate the superiority of our method.
sentences.zh: 在四个数据集上的大量实验证明了我们方法的优越性。

sentences.en: Code is available at: https://github.com/ZhangQuan-hub.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/ZhangQuan-hub 获取。

title_en: Structure-Centric Graph Foundation Model via Geometric Bases
title_zh: 基于几何基的结构中心图基础模型

sentences.en: Graph foundation models (GFMs) seek transferable representations across graph domains but are limited by structural heterogeneity and incompatible node feature spaces.
sentences.zh: 图基础模型（Graph Foundation Model，GFM）寻求跨图领域的可迁移表示，但受结构化异质性与不兼容的节点特征空间所限。

sentences.en: We propose Structure-Centric Graph Foundation Models (SCGFM), which treat graph topology as the primary source of transferable knowledge.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了结构中心图基础模型（Structure-Centric Graph Foundation Model，SCGFM），它将图拓扑视为可迁移知识的主要来源。

sentences.en: Modeling graphs as metric measure spaces, SCGFM introduces learnable geometric bases that define a shared structural coordinate system.
sentences.zh: SCGFM 将图建模为度量测度空间，并引入定义共享结构坐标系的可学习几何基。

sentences.en: Graphs are aligned to these bases via Gromov–Wasserstein distances, yielding structure-aligned latent representations that accommodate heterogeneous graph topologies.
sentences.zh: 图通过 Gromov-Wasserstein 距离与这些基对齐，产生结构对齐的潜在表示，以适应异构的图拓扑。

sentences.en: To address feature incompatibility, SCGFM employs a structure-aware feature re-encoding mechanism that unifies node representations without assuming a fixed feature dimensionality or requiring dataset-specific preprocessing.
sentences.zh: 为应对特征不兼容，SCGFM 采用一种结构感知的特征重编码机制，统一节点表示，既不假设固定的特征维度，也无需针对数据集进行特定预处理。

sentences.en: Experiments on graph- and node-level tasks demonstrate strong in-domain and cross-domain generalization, outperforming existing GFM approaches.
sentences.zh: 在图级与节点级任务上的实验展示了强大的域内与跨域泛化能力，优于现有的 GFM 方法。

title_en: Structure-Induced Information for Rerooting Levin Tree Search
title_zh: 用于重定根 Levin 树搜索的结构诱导信息

sentences.en: Subgoal-based policy tree search, which uses a policy to guide search, is effective for complex single-agent deterministic problems but often relies on explicit subgoal generation that can incur substantial overhead and hinders scalability.
sentences.zh: 基于子目标的策略树搜索使用策略来引导搜索，对复杂的单智能体确定性问题的处理很有效，但它常常依赖显式的子目标生成，这会带来可观的额外开销并阻碍可扩展性。

sentences.en: In this paper, we overcome these limitations by using a learned ``rerooter'' through the recently-introduced $\sqrt{\text{LTS}}$ algorithm.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们通过最近引入的 $\sqrt{\text{LTS}}$ 算法使用学习得到的“重定根器”（rerooter）来克服这些局限。

sentences.en: A *rerooter* implicitly decomposes the problem into soft subtasks.
sentences.zh: *重定根器*隐式地将问题分解为软子任务。

sentences.en: While previous work focused on the formal guarantees for given or handcrafted rerooters, in this work we propose three rerooter designs: (i) a clustering-based rerooter that exploits global state-space structure, (ii) a heuristic-based rerooter that leverages learned cost-to-go estimates, and (iii) a hybrid that combines both signals.
sentences.zh: 虽然先前的工作侧重于给定或手工设计重定根器的形式保证，但在这项工作中我们提出了三种重定根器设计：(i) 利用全局状态空间结构的基于聚类的重定根器；(ii) 利用学习到的代价到目标估计的基于启发式的重定根器；(iii) 结合这两种信号的混合重定根器。

sentences.en: Our framework avoids having to explicitly reconstruct and reason over generated subgoals, thereby enabling scalable allocation of search effort with significantly lower computational overhead.
sentences.zh: 我们的框架避免了显式重建并对生成的子目标进行推理的需要，从而以显著更低的计算开销实现可扩展的搜索努力分配。

sentences.en: Empirically, our rerooting-based methods scale to complex environments where subgoal-based policy tree search fails, and achieve state-of-the-art online training efficiency on the domains tested.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，我们基于重定根的方法能够扩展到基于子目标的策略树搜索失效的复杂环境，并在所测试的领域上取得了最先进的在线训练效率。

title_en: Structure-Preserving Learning Improves Geometry Generalization in Neural PDEs
title_zh: 保结构学习改善神经 PDE 中的几何泛化

sentences.en: We aim to develop physics foundation models for science and engineering that provide real-time solutions to Partial Differential Equations (PDEs) which preserve structure and accuracy under adaptation to unseen geometries.
sentences.zh: 我们旨在为科学与工程开发物理基础模型，为偏微分方程（PDE）提供实时解，并在此过程中保持结构并在适应未见几何时保持准确性。

sentences.en: To this end, we introduce General-Geometry Neural Whitney Forms (Geo-NeWF): a data-driven finite element method.
sentences.zh: 为此，我们引入了通用几何神经 Whitney 形式（General-Geometry Neural Whitney Forms，Geo-NeWF）：一种数据驱动的有限元方法。

sentences.en: We jointly learn a differential operator and compatible reduced finite element spaces defined on the underlying geometry.
sentences.zh: 我们联合学习一个微分算子与定义在底层几何上的相容降阶有限元空间。

sentences.en: The resulting model is solved to generate predictions, while exactly preserving physical conservation laws through Finite Element Exterior Calculus.
sentences.zh: 所得模型通过求解生成预测，同时借助有限元外微积分（Finite Element Exterior Calculus）精确保持物理守恒定律。

sentences.en: Geometry enters the model as a discretized mesh both through a transformer-based encoding and as the basis for the learned finite element spaces.
sentences.zh: 几何以离散网格的形式进入模型，既通过基于 Transformer 的编码，也作为学习到的有限元空间的基础。

sentences.en: This explicitly connects the underlying geometry and imposed boundary conditions to the solution, providing a powerful inductive bias for learning neural PDEs which we demonstrate improves generalization to unseen domains.
sentences.zh: 这显式地将底层几何与所施加的边界条件连接到解，为学习神经 PDE 提供了强大的归纳偏置，我们证明它能改善对未见领域的泛化。

sentences.en: We provide a novel parameterization of the constitutive model ensuring existence and uniqueness of the solution.
sentences.zh: 我们提供了本构模型的一种新颖参数化，确保解的存在性与唯一性。

sentences.en: Our approach demonstrates state-of-the-art performance on several steady-state PDE benchmarks and provides a significant improvement over conventional baselines on out-of-distribution geometries.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法在多个稳态 PDE 基准上展示了最先进的性能，并在分布外几何上相较常规基线取得了显著提升。

title_en: Structured 4D Latent Predictive Model for Robot Planning
title_zh: 用于机器人规划的结构化 4D 潜在预测模型

sentences.en: Video predictive models are emerging as a powerful paradigm in robotics, offering a promising path toward task generalization, long-horizon planning, and flexible decision-making.
sentences.zh: 视频预测模型正在成为机器人学中的强大范式，为任务泛化、长时程规划与灵活决策提供了有前景的路径。

sentences.en: However, prevailing approaches often operate on 2D video sequences, inherently lacking the 3D geometric understanding necessary for precise spatial reasoning and physical consistency.
sentences.zh: 然而，主流方法通常在 2D 视频序列上运作，本质上缺乏精确空间推理与物理一致性所需的 3D 几何理解。

sentences.en: We introduce a **Structured 4D Latent Predictive Model**, which predicts the evolution of a scene’s 3D structure in a structured latent space conditioned on observations and textual instructions.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了**结构化 4D 潜在预测模型**，它在一个结构化的潜在空间中，以观测与文本指令为条件，预测场景 3D 结构的演化。

sentences.en: Our representation encodes the scene holistically and can be decoded into diverse 3D formats, enabling a more complete and 3D consistent scene understanding.
sentences.zh: 我们的表示整体地编码场景，并可解码为多种 3D 格式，从而实现对场景更完整、更具 3D 一致性的理解。

sentences.en: This structured 4D latent predictive model serves as a planner, generating future scenes that are translated into executable actions by a goal-conditioned inverse dynamics module.
sentences.zh: 该结构化 4D 潜在预测模型充当规划器，生成未来场景，并通过目标条件化的逆动力学模块将其转化为可执行动作。

sentences.en: Experiments demonstrate that our model generates futures with strong visual quality, substantially better 3D consistency and multi-view coherence compared to state-of-the-art video-based planners.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，与最先进的基于视频的规划器相比，我们的模型生成的未来场景具有出色的视觉质量、显著更好的 3D 一致性与多视图连贯性。

sentences.en: Consequently, our full planning pipeline achieves superior performance on complex manipulation tasks, exhibits robust generalization to novel visual conditions, and proves effective on real-world robotic platforms.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们的完整规划流水线在复杂操作任务上取得了优越性能，对新颖视觉条件表现出稳健的泛化能力，并在真实世界机器人平台上被证明有效。

sentences.en: Our website is available at https://structured-4d-model.github.io/.
sentences.zh: 我们的网站可在 https://structured-4d-model.github.io/ 访问。

title_en: Structured Diffusion Bridges: Inductive Bias for Denoising Diffusion Bridges
title_zh: 结构化扩散桥：去噪扩散桥的归纳偏置

sentences.en: Modality translation is inherently under-constrained, as multiple cross-modal mappings may yield the same marginals.
sentences.zh: 模态翻译本质上是欠约束的，因为多个跨模态映射可能产生相同的边缘分布。

sentences.en: Recent work has shown that diffusion bridges are effective for this task.
sentences.zh: 近期工作表明，扩散桥（diffusion bridge）对此类任务很有效。

sentences.en: However, most existing approaches rely on fully paired datasets, thereby imposing a single data-driven constraint.
sentences.zh: 然而，大多数现有方法依赖完全配对的数据集，从而施加了单一的数据驱动约束。

sentences.en: We propose a diffusion-bridge framework that characterizes the space of admissible solutions and restricts it via alignment constraints, treating paired supervision as an optional heuristic rather than a prerequisite.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了一个扩散桥框架，它刻画可容许解的空间并通过对齐约束对其加以限制，将配对监督视为可选的启发而非前提条件。

sentences.en: We validate our method on synthetic and real modality translation benchmarks across unpaired, semi-paired, and paired regimes, showing consistent performance across supervision levels.
sentences.zh: 我们在无配对、半配对与配对等多种情形下的合成与真实模态翻译基准上验证了我们的方法，表明其在不同监督水平上具有一致的性能。

sentences.en: Notably, it achieves near fully-paired quality with a substantial relaxation in pairing requirements, and remaining applicable in the unpaired regime.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，它在大幅放宽配对要求的情况下实现了接近完全配对的质量，并且在无配对情形下仍然适用。

sentences.en: These results highlight diffusion bridges as a flexible foundation for modality translation beyond fully paired data.
sentences.zh: 这些结果凸显了扩散桥作为超越完全配对数据的模态翻译灵活基础的价值。

title_en: Structured Expert Routing with Multi-View Task Priors for Offline Meta-Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 面向离线元强化学习的结构化专家路由与多视图任务先验

sentences.en: Offline meta-reinforcement learning requires agents to generalize to unseen tasks from fixed datasets, yet existing sequence-based and MoE-based methods rely on implicit or token-level routing signals that fail to capture task-level structure.
sentences.zh: 离线元强化学习要求智能体从固定数据集中泛化到未见过的任务，然而现有的基于序列和基于 MoE 的方法依赖隐式或词元级的路由信号，无法捕获任务级结构。

sentences.en: We propose the **Task-Guided Router (TGR)**, a structured expert-routing framework that explicitly models inter-task relationships via multi-view task representations that combine semantic descriptors, behavioral summaries, and latent dynamics features.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了**任务引导路由器（TGR）**，这是一种结构化专家路由框架，通过结合语义描述符、行为摘要和潜在动力学特征的多视图任务表示，显式建模任务间关系。

sentences.en: Using structure-guided routing, TGR assigns experts based on global task compatibility rather than local trajectory fragments, enabling stable specialization and effective knowledge transfer across tasks.
sentences.zh: 借助结构引导的路由，TGR 基于全局任务兼容性而非局部轨迹片段分配专家，从而实现稳定的专业化分工和跨任务的有效知识迁移。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on continuous-control benchmarks demonstrate that TGR consistently outperforms state-of-the-art offline meta-RL methods in few-shot generalization, particularly under sparse data and heterogeneous dynamics.
sentences.zh: 在连续控制基准上的大量实验表明，TGR 在少样本泛化方面持续优于最先进的离线元强化学习方法，尤其是在稀疏数据和异构动力学条件下。

sentences.en: Our results highlight the importance of task-level priors for robust offline meta-reinforcement learning.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果凸显了任务级先验对于鲁棒的离线元强化学习的重要性。

title_en: Structured Multi-modal Graph Disentanglement for Psychiatric Diagnosis
title_zh: 面向精神疾病诊断的结构化多模态图解纠缠

sentences.en: Multi-modal neuroimaging-based psychiatric diagnosis must integrate cross-modal agreement with modality-specific complementarity, yet in real multi-site cohorts these signals are frequently entangled with site- and cohort-dependent correlations, yielding shortcut-driven predictions and limited interpretability.
sentences.zh: 基于多模态神经影像的精神疾病诊断必须整合跨模态的一致性与模态特异的互补性，然而在真实的多中心队列中，这些信号常常与依赖于研究中心和队列的相关性纠缠在一起，从而产生捷径驱动的预测和有限的解释性。

sentences.en: We propose Structured Multi-modal Graph Disentanglement (SMGD), which explicitly factorizes multi-modal graph representations into four components with distinct roles: shared diagnostic evidence, complementary diagnostic evidence, incidental cross-modal agreement, and modality-specific non-robust correlations, with the former two forming the diagnostic core and the latter two suppressed as shortcuts.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了结构化多模态图解纠缠（SMGD），它将多模态图表示显式分解为四个作用各异的组分：共享诊断证据、互补诊断证据、偶然的跨模态一致性，以及模态特异的非鲁棒相关性；其中前两者构成诊断核心，后两者被抑制为捷径。

sentences.en: SMGD is realized as geometry-driven structure learning: under a mild distributional assumption, we develop mini-batch estimable surrogate regularizers that shape subspace organization and cross-modal relations, enforcing semantic consistency through relational geometry rather than centroid coincidence while suppressing confounded dependencies.
sentences.zh: SMGD 以几何驱动的结构学习来实现：在温和的分布假设下，我们开发了可通过小批量估计的替代正则化器，用以塑造子空间组织和跨模态关系，通过关系几何而非质心重合来强制执行语义一致性，同时抑制混杂依赖。

sentences.en: Experiments on large multi-site datasets show improved in-domain diagnosis and more reliable cross-dataset generalization in the presence of a Modality Gap, without relying on expert-crafted diagnostic biomarkers.
sentences.zh: 在大型多中心数据集上的实验表明，在存在模态间隙（Modality Gap）的情况下，该方法改善了域内诊断，并在不依靠专家手工设计的诊断生物标志物的前提下，实现了更可靠的跨数据集泛化。

title_en: Structured Multi-step Jailbreaking under a Hamiltonian Generative Formulation
title_zh: 哈密顿生成公式下的结构化多步越狱

sentences.en: Recent work shows that even safety aligned large language models (LLM) can be pushed into unsafe behavior by carefully crafted jailbreak prompts.
sentences.zh: 近期研究表明，即使是经过安全对齐的大型语言模型（LLM），也可能被精心构造的越狱提示推入不安全的行为。

sentences.en: Existing jailbreaking attack methods often rely on disfluent or incoherent prompts, which limit their success and make them easy to detect.
sentences.zh: 现有的越狱攻击方法常常依赖不流畅或前后不一致的提示，这限制了其成功率，并使其易于被检测。

sentences.en: We introduce SJA, a structured jailbreak attack built around two ideas.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 SJA，一种围绕两个核心思想构建的结构化越狱攻击。

sentences.en: First, inspired by the logic of Spilsbury puzzle, SJA decomposes a harmful query into a sequence of harmless sub-questions and reconstructs the original answer by combining the sub-question responses.
sentences.zh: 首先，受 Spilsbury 拼图逻辑的启发，SJA 将有害查询分解为一系列无害的子问题，并通过组合子问题的响应来重构原始答案。

sentences.en: Second, by leveraging the theory of Hamiltonian dynamics on hyperbolic space, we propose a hyperbolic Hamiltonian dynamics-based sub-question generation framework that effectively captures the structural and temporal dependencies.
sentences.zh: 其次，借助双曲空间上的哈密顿动力学理论，我们提出了一种基于双曲哈密顿动力学的子问题生成框架，能够有效捕获结构和时间依赖关系。

sentences.en: We provide a theoretical analysis of how each sub-question evolves along the trajectory and show that the hyperbolic Hamiltonian system effectively captures the underlying semantic structure.
sentences.zh: 我们提供了关于每个子问题如何沿轨迹演化的理论分析，并表明双曲哈密顿系统能够有效捕获潜在的语义结构。

sentences.en: Finally, we propose a hyperbolic narrative fusion mechanism built on fractional embedding and Möbius fusion.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们提出了一种基于分数阶嵌入和 Möbius 融合的双曲叙事融合机制。

sentences.en: This mechanism integrates coherent narratives into sub-questions while preserving geometric consistency and improving stealth performance.
sentences.zh: 该机制将连贯的叙事整合到子问题中，同时保持几何一致性并提升隐蔽性能。

sentences.en: We theoretically validate that the combination of the generated harmless sub-questions, guided by the stealthy narrative, can effectively preserve the contextual semantics of the original harmful question.
sentences.zh: 我们从理论上验证，受隐蔽叙事引导的、由生成的无害子问题构成的组合，能够有效保留原始有害问题的上下文语义。

title_en: Structured Progressive Knowledge Activation for LLM-Driven Neural Architecture Search
title_zh: 面向 LLM 驱动的神经架构搜索的结构化递进知识激活

sentences.en: This paper focuses on a key challenge in Neural Architecture Search (NAS): integrating established architectural knowledge while exploring new designs under expensive evaluations.
sentences.zh: 本文聚焦神经架构搜索（NAS）中的一个关键挑战：在昂贵的评估条件下，在探索新设计的同时整合已有架构知识。

sentences.en: Large language models (LLMs) are a promising assistant for NAS because they can translate rich architectural and coding priors into executable code edits.
sentences.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）是 NAS 有前景的辅助工具，因为它们能将丰富的架构与编码先验转化为可执行的代码编辑。

sentences.en: However, in practice, seemingly local revisions often propagate into non-local behavioral and performance shifts because a single edit can inadvertently couple multiple interacting functional factors, a phenomenon we refer to as functional entanglement.
sentences.zh: 然而在实践中，看似局部的修改常常会传播为非局部的行为和性能变化，因为单次编辑可能无意中耦合多个相互交互的功能因素，我们将此现象称为功能纠缠。

sentences.en: To make LLM knowledge usable under such entanglement, we propose Structured Progressive Knowledge Activation (SPARK), which activates relevant priors by explicitly selecting the functional factor to modify and conditioning the edit on that factor.
sentences.zh: 为了使 LLM 知识在这种纠缠下可用，我们提出了结构化递进知识激活（SPARK），它通过显式选择要修改的功能因素并以此因素为条件进行编辑来激活相关先验。

sentences.en: This factor-conditioned editing reduces entangled side effects and yields more targeted, reliable architecture modifications.
sentences.zh: 这种以因素为条件的编辑减少了纠缠的副作用，并产生更具针对性、更可靠的架构修改。

sentences.en: On CLRS-DFS, SPARK achieves a 28.1x sample-efficient architecture evolution speedup and yields a 22.9% relative improvement in OOD accuracy.
sentences.zh: 在 CLRS-DFS 上，SPARK 实现了 28.1 倍的样本高效架构演进加速，并在 OOD 准确率上取得了 22.9% 的相对提升。

sentences.en: Our code is available at https://github.com/AIM-ResearchLab/SPARK.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/AIM-ResearchLab/SPARK 获取。

title_en: STT-LLM: Structural-Temporal Tokenization for Adapting LLMs to Longitudinal Clinical Profiles
title_zh: STT-LLM：面向纵向临床画像适配 LLM 的结构-时间分词

sentences.en: Large Language Models have shown strong generalization across natural language tasks but remain underexplored for longitudinal clinical profiles.
sentences.zh: 大型语言模型在自然语言任务上表现出很强的泛化能力，但在纵向临床画像方面仍未得到充分探索。

sentences.en: In sports anti-doping, biological profiles are analyzed to support early detection of prohibited substance use and identification of anomalous biological patterns, both of which require joint modeling of temporal dynamics and metabolic relationships.
sentences.zh: 在体育反兴奋剂领域，分析生物画像以支持早期检测禁用物质的使用并识别异常生物模式，这两者都需要对时间动态和代谢关系进行联合建模。

sentences.en: We propose STT-LLM, a structural-temporal tokenization framework that adapts LLMs to longitudinal clinical analysis without modifying their backbone architectures.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 STT-LLM，一种结构-时间分词框架，在不修改骨干架构的情况下将 LLM 适配到纵向临床分析。

sentences.en: STT-LLM constructs biologically grounded structural-temporal embeddings and transforms them into LLM-compatible tokens via specialized tokenizers that explicitly encode pathway structure and temporal evolution.
sentences.zh: STT-LLM 构建具有生物学基础的结构-时间嵌入，并通过专门的分词器将其转化为 LLM 兼容的词元，这些分词器显式编码通路结构和时间演化。

sentences.en: We evaluate STT-LLM on real-world longitudinal datasets from athletes, showing consistent improvements over native LLM tokenization strategies in sequence prediction and anomaly detection.
sentences.zh: 我们在来自运动员的真实世界纵向数据集上评估了 STT-LLM，在序列预测和异常检测方面一致优于原生 LLM 分词策略。

sentences.en: In addition, we present a case study where STT-LLM provides contextual reasoning that aligns more closely with expert assessments compared to baseline models.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们展示了一个案例研究，与基线模型相比，STT-LLM 提供的上下文推理与专家评估更为一致。

sentences.en: These results highlight tokenization as a key bottleneck and opportunity for adapting LLMs to clinical data.
sentences.zh: 这些结果表明，分词是使 LLM 适配临床数据的一个关键瓶颈和机遇。

title_en: Student-Centered Distillation Narrows the Agentic Gap Between Small and Large LLMs
title_zh: 以学生为中心的蒸馏缩小小型与大型 LLM 之间的智能体差距

sentences.en: Large Language Model agents achieve strong performance on multi-step reasoning and tool-use tasks, but their impressive capabilities typically rely on extremely large backbones.
sentences.zh: 大型语言模型智能体在多步推理和工具使用任务上表现出色，但其令人印象深刻的性能通常依赖于极其庞大的骨干网络。

sentences.en: Existing distillation approaches train smaller students to imitate full teacher trajectories, yet reasoning and knowledge gaps between the teacher and student can cause compounding errors.
sentences.zh: 现有的蒸馏方法训练较小的学生模型去模仿教师的完整轨迹，然而师生之间在推理和知识上的差距会导致误差累积。

sentences.en: We propose SCoRe, a student-centered framework in which the student generates training trajectories and the teacher corrects only the earliest error, producing training data matched to the student's abilities and exposing specific weaknesses.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 SCoRe，一种以学生为中心的框架：由学生生成训练轨迹，教师仅纠正最早出现的错误，从而产生与学生能力相匹配的训练数据，并暴露其具体的弱点。

sentences.en: The student is first fine-tuned on corrected trajectories.
sentences.zh: 学生模型首先在纠正后的轨迹上进行微调。

sentences.en: Subsequently, short-horizon reinforcement learning starts from the verified prefix preceding the earliest error, with target rewards assigned at that step.
sentences.zh: 随后，短视界强化学习从最早错误之前的已验证前缀出发，并在该步骤分配目标奖励。

sentences.en: This design enables the student to solve problems through unconstrained RL exploration rather than teacher imitation, while the short-horizon setup improves training stability.
sentences.zh: 这种设计使学生能够通过不受约束的强化学习探索而非教师模仿来解决问题，同时短视界设置提高了训练稳定性。

sentences.en: On 12 challenging benchmarks, a 7B-parameter student distilled with SCoRe closes the agentic performance gap with a 72B-parameter teacher.
sentences.zh: 在 12 个具有挑战性的基准上，使用 SCoRe 蒸馏出的 7B 参数学生模型缩小了与 72B 参数教师模型之间的智能体性能差距。

title_en: StyleDistillation: A New Insight of Image Style Enables Personalized Aesthetic Manipulation
title_zh: StyleDistillation：图像风格的新洞见实现个性化美学操控

sentences.en: Text-guided stylized image generation has yielded promising advances by leveraging the powerful capabilities of text-to-image diffusion models.
sentences.zh: 文本引导的风格化图像生成凭借文本到图像扩散模型的强大能力取得了令人瞩目的进展。

sentences.en: However, the inherent coupling of style and content information within the reference image presents a significant challenge.
sentences.zh: 然而，参考图像中风格与内容信息的固有耦合带来了重大挑战。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose StyleDistillation, a novel approach grounded in two key observations about the CLIP embedding space from a style perspective.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一问题，我们提出了 StyleDistillation，一种基于从风格视角对 CLIP 嵌入空间的两项关键观察的新方法。

sentences.en: By leveraging a lightweight StyleDistiller module, combined with carefully designed optimization objectives based on geometric and semantic priors, we can extract fine-grained style representation from the reference image.
sentences.zh: 通过利用轻量级 StyleDistiller 模块，并结合基于几何与语义先验精心设计的优化目标，我们可以从参考图像中提取细粒度风格表示。

sentences.en: Additionally, we introduce a Prompt Alignment Enhancement mechanism during inference, which significantly improves the control that text prompts exert over the generated images.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们在推理阶段引入了提示对齐增强机制，显著提升了文本提示对生成图像的控制力。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves outstanding performance in both style reproduction and prompt alignment.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，我们的方法在风格再现和提示对齐两方面都取得了出色表现。

sentences.en: Furthermore, StyleDistillation supports various personalized operations, including style editing and style fusion, highlighting its substantial potential for diverse applications.
sentences.zh: 此外，StyleDistillation 支持多种个性化操作，包括风格编辑和风格融合，凸显了其在多种应用中的巨大潜力。

title_en: Subgroup Discovery with the Cox Model
title_zh: 基于 Cox 模型的子群体发现问题

sentences.en: We study the problem of subgroup discovery for survival analysis, where the goal is to find an interpretable subset of the data on which a Cox model is highly accurate.
sentences.zh: 我们研究生存分析的子群体发现问题，其目标是找到数据中一个可解释的子集，使得 Cox 模型在该子集上具有很高的准确率。

sentences.en: We examine why existing quality functions are insufficient for this problem and introduce two technical innovations: the *expected prediction entropy (EPE)*, a novel metric for evaluating survival models that predict hazard functions, and the *conditional rank statistics (CRS)*, which quantifies individual point deviation from a subgroup's survival time distribution.
sentences.zh: 我们考察了现有质量函数为何不足以解决这一问题，并引入两项技术创新：*期望预测熵（EPE）*，一种用于评估预测风险函数的生存模型的新指标，以及*条件秩统计量（CRS）*，它量化了单个点与子群体生存时间分布的偏差。

sentences.en: We study the EPE and CRS theoretically and show they address problems with existing metrics.
sentences.zh: 我们从理论上研究了 EPE 和 CRS，并表明它们解决了现有指标存在的问题。

sentences.en: We then introduce eight algorithms for Cox subgroup discovery.
sentences.zh: 随后我们提出了八种用于 Cox 子群体发现的算法。

sentences.en: Our main algorithm is based on the DDGroup framework of Izzo et al. (2023) and leverages both the EPE and CRS, allowing theoretical correctness guarantees in well-specified settings.
sentences.zh: 我们的主要算法基于 Izzo 等人（2023）的 DDGroup 框架，同时利用 EPE 和 CRS，从而在设定良好的场景下提供理论正确性保证。

sentences.en: Empirical evaluation on synthetic and real data confirms our theory, showing our methods recover ground-truth subgroups in well-specified cases and achieve better model fit than naively fitting the Cox model to the entire dataset.
sentences.zh: 在合成数据和真实数据上的实证评估证实了我们的理论，表明我们的方法能在设定良好的情况下恢复真实子群体，并且比将 Cox 模型直接拟合到整个数据集获得更优的模型拟合。

sentences.en: A case study on NASA jet engine simulation data demonstrates that discovered subgroups uncover known nonlinearities in the data and suggest design choices mirrored in practice.
sentences.zh: 一项针对 NASA 喷气发动机仿真数据的案例研究表明，发现的子群体揭示了数据中已知的非线性，并提出了与实践相呼应的设计选择。

title_en: Subliminal Effects in Your Data: A General Mechanism via Log-Linearity
title_zh: 数据中的阈下效应：一种基于对数线性的一般机制

sentences.en: Training modern large language models (LLMs) has become a veritable smorgasbord of algorithms and datasets designed to elicit particular behaviors, making it critical to develop techniques to understand the effects of datasets on the model's properties.
sentences.zh: 训练现代大型语言模型（LLM）已成为一种名副其实的算法与数据集大杂烩，这些算法和数据集旨在引出特定行为，因此开发能够理解数据集对模型属性影响的技术变得至关重要。

sentences.en: This is exacerbated by recent experiments that show datasets can transmit signals that are not directly observable from individual datapoints (Halawi et al., 2024; Betley et al., 2025b;Cloud et al., 2025; Betley et al., 2025a), posing a conceptual challenge for dataset-centric understandings of LLM training and suggesting a missing fundamental account of such phenomena.
sentences.zh: 近期的实验加剧了这一问题，这些实验表明数据集可以传递无法从单个数据点直接观察到的信号（Halawi 等人，2024；Betley 等人，2025b；Cloud 等人，2025；Betley 等人，2025a），这对以数据集为中心的 LLM 训练理解构成了概念性挑战，并暗示对此类现象缺乏一个基本的解释。

sentences.en: Towards understanding such effects, inspired by recent work on the linear structure of LLMs (Park et al., 2024; Golowich et al., 2025b), we uncover a general mechanism through which hidden subtexts can arise in generic datasets.
sentences.zh: 为理解此类效应，受近期关于 LLM 线性结构研究（Park 等人，2024；Golowich 等人，2025b）的启发，我们揭示了一种通用数据集中的隐含子文本得以产生的一般机制。

sentences.en: We introduce LOGIT-LINEAR SELECTION (LLS), a method that prescribes how to select subsets of a generic preference dataset to elicit a wide range of hidden effects.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了对数线性选择（LLS）方法，它规定了如何从通用偏好数据集中选择子集，以引出一系列广泛的隐含效应。

sentences.en: We apply LLS to discover subsets of real-world datasets so that models trained on them exhibit behaviors ranging from having specific preferences, to responding to prompts in a different language not present in the dataset, to taking on a different persona.
sentences.zh: 我们应用 LLS 从真实世界数据集中发现子集，使得在其上训练的模型展现出从具有特定偏好、到以数据集中不存在的不同语言响应提示、再到呈现不同人设等各种行为。

sentences.en: Crucially, the effect persists for the selected subset, across models with varying architectures, supporting its generality and universality.
sentences.zh: 至关重要的是，这种效应在所选子集上持续存在，并跨越具有不同架构的模型，支持了其普遍性与通用性。

title_en: Submodular Optimization for Minimal Augmentation in Robust Language Model Alignment
title_zh: 鲁棒语言模型对齐中最小增强的子模优化

sentences.en: Safety alignment of large language models is fragile: even small fine-tuning perturbations elastically revert behaviors toward those of the pre-training, with degradation inversely proportional to the size of the alignment set.
sentences.zh: 大型语言模型的安全对齐是脆弱的：即使是微小的微调扰动也会弹性地使行为回退到预训练时的行为，退化程度与对齐集合的大小成反比。

sentences.en: We ask how to achieve safety alignment with minimal augmentation.
sentences.zh: 我们探讨如何以最小的增强实现安全对齐。

sentences.en: To this end, we model augmentation as a set of group actions on sequences and formalize robustness gains as a normalized, monotone submodular function over transformations.
sentences.zh: 为此，我们将增强建模为作用于序列的一组群操作，并将鲁棒性提升形式化为变换上的归一化单调子模函数。

sentences.en: We then leverage submodular optimization to select minimal augmentations that provably improve robustness.
sentences.zh: 随后我们利用子模优化来选择可证明提升鲁棒性的最小增强。

sentences.en: Experiments confirm that our approach efficiently restores safety alignment while minimizing the overhead of augmentation.
sentences.zh: 实验证实，我们的方法在最小化增强开销的同时，能高效恢复安全对齐。

title_en: Subspace-Aware Feature Reshaping for Open-Set Graph Class-Incremental Learning
title_zh: 面向开放集图类增量学习的子空间感知特征重塑

sentences.en: Graph class-incremental learning (GCIL) has emerged to address the challenge of learning from dynamically evolving graphs, which continuously learns new classes over a sequence of tasks while retaining performance on previously seen classes.
sentences.zh: 图类增量学习（GCIL）应运而生，以应对从动态演化图中学习的挑战，它在一系列任务上持续学习新类别，同时保持对先前已见类别的性能。

sentences.en: However, existing GCIL methods assume a closed-set test distribution drawn only from seen tasks.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的 GCIL 方法假设测试分布是封闭集，仅来自已见过的任务。

sentences.en: This fundamentally contradicts real-world open-ended scenarios where future unknown classes inevitably emerge.
sentences.zh: 这与现实世界的开放场景根本矛盾，因为在真实环境中未来的未知类别不可避免会出现。

sentences.en: Empirically, we observe that existing GCIL methods falter in such open-set settings due to severe representation drift and generalized overconfidence.
sentences.zh: 实证上，我们观察到现有的 GCIL 方法在这种开放集设置下由于严重的表示漂移和过度自信而表现不佳。

sentences.en: To bridge this gap, we investigate the Open-Set GCIL problem and propose \textbf{SAFER} (\underline{S}ubspace-\underline{A}ware \underline{FE}ature \underline{R}eshaping), a novel framework that endows GCIL with intrinsic open-set capabilities under a replay-free constraint.
sentences.zh: 为弥合这一差距，我们研究开放集 GCIL 问题，并提出 \textbf{SAFER}\（\underline{S}ubspace-\underline{A}ware \underline{FE}ature \underline{R}eshaping），一种新颖框架，它在无回放约束下赋予 GCIL 内在的开放集能力。

sentences.en: Specifically, \textbf{SAFER} performs subspace-aware feature reshaping with drift-free fingerprints, unifying task routing and open-set rejection into a single energy-based metric.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，\textbf{SAFER} 利用无漂移指纹执行子空间感知特征重塑，将任务路由与开放集拒绝统一到单一的基于能量的度量中。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we introduce a geometric space-consistency regularization that explicitly improves intra-class compactness and suppresses cross-task representation drift.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们引入一种几何空间一致性正则化，显式提升类内紧致性并抑制跨任务表示漂移。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on four benchmarks demonstrate that SAFER outperforms state-of-the-art baselines by margins of up to 5.2\% in accuracy and 31.3\% in open-set AUROC, all while maintaining near-zero forgetting under strict no-replay constraints.
sentences.zh: 在四个基准上的大量实验表明，SAFER 在准确率上最高优于最先进基线 5.2\%，在开放集 AUROC 上最高优于 31.3\%，同时严格遵守无回放约束并保持近零遗忘。

title_en: SubspacePath Pruner: Inference-time Pruning via Probe-based Representation–Parameter Coupling
title_zh: SubspacePath Pruner：基于探针的表示-参数耦合实现推理时剪枝

sentences.en: Large-scale dedicated application of LLMs in diverse scenarios increasingly demands specialized model inference behavior under strict constraints of accuracy, latency, and memory.
sentences.zh: 大型语言模型在各种场景中的大规模专用部署，日益要求在准确率、延迟和内存的严格约束下实现专门的模型推理行为。

sentences.en: However, the heterogeneous and long-tailed nature of real-world specialized scenarios makes it difficult to obtain training data and optimize models.
sentences.zh: 然而，真实世界专用场景的异质性和长尾性使得获取训练数据和优化模型都很困难。

sentences.en: We study a practical inference-time specialization setting: given an LLM base, we compile a reusable, budget-bounded pathway/subnetwork within a specific scenario.
sentences.zh: 我们研究一种实用的推理时特化设定：给定一个 LLM 基座，在特定场景内编译一条可复用、受预算约束的通路/子网络。

sentences.en: Our approach is motivated by an empirical coupling phenomenon: input scenario sets aligned with similar representation subspaces (e.g., domain) in embedding space tend to activate a consistent and sparse set of internal reasoning pathways in model parameter space.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法源于一个经验耦合现象：在嵌入空间中与相似表示子空间（例如领域）对齐的输入场景集合，往往会在模型参数空间中激活一组一致且稀疏的内部推理通路。

sentences.en: To build the bridge between them, we propose probe-based SubspacePath Pruner with two core components: (1) Domain-Basis Synthesis (DBS) constructs a quasi-orthogonal basis of domain axes in embedding space, serving as a stable coordinate system.
sentences.zh: 为了在两者之间架起桥梁，我们提出基于探针的 SubspacePath Pruner，它包含两个核心组件：（1）域基合成（DBS）在嵌入空间中构建领域轴的准正交基，充当稳定的坐标系。

sentences.en: (2) Probe-based Scenario Pruning (PSP) uses efficient layer-wise linear probes to estimate axis alignment and compute budgeted head-wise pathways for a specific scenario.
sentences.zh: （2）基于探针的场景剪枝（PSP）使用高效的逐层线性探针估计轴对齐程度，并为特定场景计算受预算约束的逐注意力头通路。

sentences.en: Experiments on LLaMA-2-13B show 29.3 average Recall on cross-domain tests (vs. 24.7 dense) and 21.6 on cross-dataset tests (vs. 25.5 dense) with 1.27x speedup at ~30% pruning ratio.
sentences.zh: 在 LLaMA-2-13B 上的实验显示，跨域测试的平均召回率为 29.3（稠密为 24.7），跨数据集测试为 21.6（稠密为 25.5），在约 30% 剪枝率下实现了 1.27 倍加速。

title_en: Success-Conditioning as Policy Improvement: The Optimization Problem Solved by Imitating Success
title_zh: 将成功条件化作为策略改进：通过模仿成功求解的优化问题

sentences.en: A widely used technique for improving policies is success conditioning, in which one collects trajectories, identifies those that achieve a desired outcome, and updates the policy to imitate the actions taken along successful trajectories.
sentences.zh: 一种广泛使用的策略改进技术是成功条件化，即收集轨迹、识别达到预期结果的轨迹，并更新策略以模仿成功轨迹沿线的动作。

sentences.en: This principle appears under many names---rejection sampling with SFT, goal-conditioned RL, Decision Transformers---yet what optimization problem it solves, if any, has remained unclear.
sentences.zh: 这一原则以多种名称出现——结合 SFT 的拒绝采样、目标条件化强化学习、Decision Transformers——但它（如果有的话）究竟求解了什么优化问题，一直不清楚。

sentences.en: We prove that success conditioning exactly solves a trust-region optimization problem, maximizing policy improvement subject to a $\chi^2$ divergence constraint whose radius is determined automatically by the data.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了成功条件化恰好求解一个信赖域优化问题，即在受 $\chi^2$ 散度约束的条件下最大化策略改进，该约束的半径由数据自动决定。

sentences.en: This yields an identity: relative policy improvement, the magnitude of policy change, and a quantity we call action-influence---measuring how random variation in action choices affects success rates---are exactly equal at every state.
sentences.zh: 这产生了一个恒等式：相对策略改进、策略变化幅度以及我们称为动作影响力——衡量动作选择的随机变化如何影响成功率——的量，在每个状态上都完全相等。

sentences.en: Success conditioning thus emerges as a conservative improvement operator.
sentences.zh: 因此，成功条件化呈现出一种保守改进算子的特性。

sentences.en: Exact success conditioning cannot degrade performance or induce dangerous distribution shift, but when it fails, it does so observably, by hardly changing the policy at all.
sentences.zh: 精确的成功条件化不会降低性能或诱发危险的分布偏移，但当它失效时，其失效方式是可观测的，即几乎完全不改变策略。

sentences.en: We apply our theory to the common practice of return thresholding, showing this can amplify improvement, but at the cost of potential misalignment with the true objective.
sentences.zh: 我们将我们的理论应用于常见的回报阈值化实践，表明这可以放大改进，但代价是可能与真实目标产生错配。

title_en: SuCo: Sufficiency-guided Continuous Adaptive Reasoning
title_zh: SuCo：充分性引导的连续自适应推理

sentences.en: Despite remarkable performance on complex tasks, Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) often generate excessively long Chain-of-Thoughts (CoT), inflating computational costs even for simple queries.
sentences.zh: 尽管大型推理模型（LRM）在复杂任务上表现出色，但它们常常会生成过长的思维链（CoT），即使面对简单查询也会显著增加计算成本。

sentences.en: Existing efforts to mitigate this inefficiency typically rely on discrete reasoning modes or fixed budget tiers, lacking a principled criterion of when reasoning is sufficient.
sentences.zh: 为缓解这一低效问题的现有工作，通常依赖离散的推理模式或固定的预算分级，缺乏关于推理何时才充分的原理性判据。

sentences.en: In this work, we introduce *Minimal Sufficient CoT* (MSC), defined as the shortest prefix of a CoT trajectory which is adequate for producing the correct answer.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们引入了*最小充分思维链*（MSC），定义为 CoT 轨迹中最短的前缀，且该前缀足以生成正确答案。

sentences.en: We empirically show that MSC not only reduces reasoning tokens, but also improves accuracy across difficulty levels.
sentences.zh: 我们实证表明，MSC 不仅能减少推理词元，还能在各个难度级别上提升准确率。

sentences.en: Building on MSC, we propose *Sufficiency-guided Continuous Adaptive Reasoning* (SuCo), a two-stage training framework for autonomous reasoning control along a continuous spectrum.
sentences.zh: 在 MSC 的基础上，我们提出*充分性引导的连续自适应推理*（SuCo），一种沿连续谱实现自主推理控制的两阶段训练框架。

sentences.en: In stage 1, *MSC-Aligned Fine-Tuning* (MFT) constructs MSC data using problem-adaptive sufficiency thresholds that naturally scale with question difficulty, then fine-tunes the model to internalize concise yet sufficient reasoning patterns.
sentences.zh: 在第一阶段，*MSC 对齐微调*（MFT）使用随问题难度自然缩放的问题自适应充分性阈值来构建 MSC 数据，然后微调模型，使其内化简洁而充分的推理模式。

sentences.en: In stage 2,  *Sufficiency-Aware Policy Optimization* (SAPO) further optimizes the model through reinforcement learning with dynamic complexity tracking and sufficiency-aware rewards that penalize both over- and under-thinking.
sentences.zh: 在第二阶段，*充分性感知策略优化*（SAPO）通过强化学习进一步优化模型，采用动态复杂度跟踪和充分性感知奖励，同时惩罚过度思考与思考不足。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across mathematics, code, and science benchmarks show that SuCo consistently achieves improvements in both accuracy and reasoning efficiency.
sentences.zh: 在数学、代码和科学基准上的大量实验表明，SuCo 在准确率和推理效率两方面都持续取得提升。

title_en: SuperHype: Hypergraph Generation via Graph-Superposition Decomposition
title_zh: SuperHype：通过图-超图重叠分解进行超图生成

sentences.en: Hypergraphs are graph generalizations with key applications in domains such as healthcare, where strict data privacy requirements apply, or bioinformatics, where testing new compounds is costly.
sentences.zh: 超图是图的推广，在医疗保健（严格的数据隐私要求）和生物信息学（测试新化合物成本高昂）等领域具有关键应用。

sentences.en: However, due to their combinatorial nature, hypergraph representations are often either intractable or lead to significant information loss.
sentences.zh: 然而，由于超图的组合性质，其表示往往要么难以处理，要么导致显著的信息损失。

sentences.en: For this reason, research into hypergraph synthesis is limited, and state-of-the-art approaches yield poor generation quality in terms of overall structural patterns and graph-level validity.
sentences.zh: 因此，超图合成的相关研究十分有限，最先进的方法在整体结构模式和图级有效性方面生成的质量较差。

sentences.en: To address such shortcomings, we introduce SuperHype, an exact and tractable hypergraph diffusion model.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些不足，我们提出了 SuperHype，一种精确且可处理的超图扩散模型。

sentences.en: The core of SuperHype is the graph-superposition decomposition,  a novel representation that embeds a hypergraph into a multi-layer graph, enabling a tractable representation with no loss of generalization.
sentences.zh: SuperHype 的核心是图-超图重叠分解，一种将超图嵌入到多层图中的新表示，从而在无泛化损失的前提下实现可处理的表示。

sentences.en: To generate new samples from such representations, we introduce a Graph-Superposition Transformer that treats the superposition as an interconnected sequence of layers.
sentences.zh: 为了从这类表示中生成新样本，我们引入了一个图-超图重叠 Transformer，它将重叠视作由相互连接的层组成的序列。

sentences.en: Moreover, we enhance the model's performance by incorporating hypergraph-specific auxiliary features and aggregating indirect node interactions via triplet pooling.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们通过纳入超图特异的辅助特征，并借助三元组池化聚合间接的节点交互，来提升模型的性能。

sentences.en: Our evaluation across five datasets shows that SuperHype generally reproduces local and global connectivity patterns with superior fidelity compared to state-of-the-art baselines.
sentences.zh: 我们在五个数据集上的评估表明，与最先进的基线相比，SuperHype 通常能以更高的保真度再现局部和全局连通模式。

title_en: Supervise Less, See More: Training-free Nuclear Instance Segmentation with Prototype-Guided Prompting
title_zh: 少监督，多看见：基于原型引导提示的无训练细胞核实例分割

sentences.en: Accurate nuclear instance segmentation is a pivotal task in computational pathology, supporting data-driven clinical insights and facilitating downstream translational applications.
sentences.zh: 准确的细胞核实例分割是计算病理学中的关键任务，支撑数据驱动的临床洞察，并促进下游转化应用。

sentences.en: While large vision foundation models have shown promise for zero-shot biomedical segmentation, most existing approaches still depend on dense supervision and computationally expensive fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: 虽然大型视觉基座模型在零样本生物医学分割方面已展现出潜力，但大多数现有方法仍依赖密集监督和计算昂贵的微调。

sentences.en: Consequently, training-free methods present a compelling research direction, yet remain largely unexplored.
sentences.zh: 因此，无训练方法展现了一条引人注目的研究方向，但至今仍基本未被探索。

sentences.en: In this work, we introduce SPROUT, a fully training- and annotation-free prompting framework for nuclear instance segmentation.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了 SPROUT，一种完全无需训练和标注的细胞核实例分割提示框架。

sentences.en: SPROUT leverages histology-informed priors to construct slide-specific reference prototypes that mitigate domain gaps.
sentences.zh: SPROUT 利用组织学先验知识构建切片特异的参考原型，以缓解领域差距。

sentences.en: These prototypes progressively guide feature alignment through a partial optimal transport scheme.
sentences.zh: 这些原型通过部分最优传输方案逐步引导特征对齐。

sentences.en: The resulting foreground and background features are transformed into positive and negative point prompts, enabling the Segment Anything Model (SAM) to produce precise nuclear delineations without any parameter updates.
sentences.zh: 所得的前景和背景特征被转化为正负点提示，使 Segment Anything Model（SAM）无需任何参数更新即可生成精确的细胞核轮廓。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across multiple histopathology benchmarks demonstrate that SPROUT achieves competitive performance without supervision or retraining, establishing a novel paradigm for scalable, training-free nuclear instance segmentation in pathology.
sentences.zh: 横跨多个组织病理学基准的大量实验表明，SPROUT 在无需监督或重新训练的情况下实现了具有竞争力的性能，为病理学中可扩展、无训练的细胞核实例分割确立了新的范式。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/Y-Research-SBU/SPROUT.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/Y-Research-SBU/SPROUT 获取。

title_en: Supervised Classification Heads as Semantic Prototypes: Unlocking Vision-Language Alignment via Weight Recycling
title_zh: 将监督分类头用作语义原型：通过权重重用解锁视觉-语言对齐

sentences.en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) excel at tasks like zero-shot classification and cross-modal retrieval by mapping images and text to a shared space, but this requires expensive end-to-end training with massive paired datasets.
sentences.zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）通过将图像和文本映射到共享空间，在零样本分类和跨模态检索等任务上表现出色，但这需要利用大规模配对数据集进行昂贵的端到端训练。

sentences.en: Current post-hoc alignment methods reduce computational costs by connecting pretrained encoders through lightweight mappings, yet still demand substantial paired data.
sentences.zh: 当前的事后对齐方法通过轻量级映射连接预训练编码器来降低计算成本，但仍然需要大量配对数据。

sentences.en: In this work, we investigate the potential of repurposing the classification heads of pretrained vision models as semantic prototypes.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们研究了将预训练视觉模型的分类头重新用作语义原型的潜力。

sentences.en: The recycling of these weights, typically discarded after pretraining, unlocks two distinct capabilities: it enables zero-shot alignment by using weights as semantic anchors, and serves as a robust data augmentation strategy by mixing these prototypes with real image-text pairs.
sentences.zh: 这些通常在预训练后被丢弃的权重的重用，解锁了两种不同的能力：它通过将权重用作语义锚点实现零样本对齐，并通过将这些原型与真实图像-文本对混合，充当一种稳健的数据增强策略。

sentences.en: We demonstrate that integrating our approach with several state-of-the-art post-hoc alignment techniques consistently boosts accuracy in cross-modal retrieval, zero- and few-shot classification tasks.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，将我们的方法与多种最先进的事后对齐技术相结合，可以持续提升跨模态检索、零样本和少样本分类任务的准确率。

title_en: Supervised Graph Contrastive Learning for Gene Regulatory Networks
title_zh: 用于基因调控网络的监督图对比学习

sentences.en: Graph Contrastive Learning (GCL) is a powerful self-supervised learning framework that performs data augmentation through graph perturbations, with growing applications in the analysis of biological networks such as Gene Regulatory Networks (GRNs).
sentences.zh: 图对比学习（GCL）是一种强大的自监督学习框架，通过图扰动进行数据增强，在基因调控网络（GRN）等生物网络分析中的应用日益增多。

sentences.en: The artificial perturbations commonly used in GCL, such as node dropping, induce structural changes that can diverge from biological reality.
sentences.zh: GCL 中常用的人工扰动（例如节点丢弃）会引发结构变化，而这些变化可能与生物学现实相背离。

sentences.en: This concern has contributed to a broader trend in graph representation learning toward augmentation-free methods, which view such structural changes as problematic and should be avoided.
sentences.zh: 这一担忧促成了图表示学习中向无增强方法发展的更广泛趋势，这些方法将此类结构变化视为有问题的并应予以避免。

sentences.en: However, this trend overlooks the fundamental insight that structural changes from biologically meaningful perturbations are not a problem to be avoided, but rather a rich source of information, thereby ignoring the valuable opportunity to leverage data from real biological experiments.
sentences.zh: 然而，这一趋势忽略了这样一个基本洞见：由具有生物学意义的扰动引起的结构变化并非需要避免的问题，而是丰富的信息来源，从而忽视了利用真实生物实验数据这一宝贵机会。

sentences.en: Motivated by this insight, we propose SupGCL (Supervised Graph Contrastive Learning), a new GCL method for GRNs that directly incorporates biological perturbations from gene knockdown experiments as supervision.
sentences.zh: 受这一洞见的启发，我们提出了 SupGCL（有监督图对比学习），一种新的用于 GRN 的 GCL 方法，它直接将来自基因敲低实验的生物扰动作为监督信号纳入。

sentences.en: SupGCL is a probabilistic formulation that continuously generalizes conventional GCL, linking artificial augmentations with real perturbations measured in knockdown experiments, and using the latter as explicit supervision.
sentences.zh: SupGCL 是一种概率框架，持续推广了传统 GCL，将人工增强与敲低实验中测量的真实扰动联系起来，并以后者作为显式监督。

sentences.en: On patient-derived GRNs from three cancer types, we train GRN representations with SupGCL and evaluate it in two regimes: (i) embedding space analysis, where it yields clearer disease-subtype structure and improves clustering, and (ii) task-specific fine-tuning, where it consistently outperforms strong graph representation learning baselines on 13 downstream tasks spanning gene-level functional annotation and patient-level prediction.
sentences.zh: 在来自三种癌症类型的患者来源 GRN 上，我们使用 SupGCL 训练 GRN 表示，并在两种范式中评估：其一是嵌入空间分析，其中它产生了更清晰的疾病亚型结构并改善了聚类；其二是任务特异的微调，其中它在覆盖基因级功能注释和患者级预测的 13 个下游任务上持续优于强大的图表示学习基线。

title_en: Supervised Guidance Training for Infinite-Dimensional Diffusion Models
title_zh: 无限维扩散模型的有监督引导训练

sentences.en: Score-based diffusion models have recently been extended to infinite-dimensional function spaces, with uses such as inverse problems arising from partial differential equations.
sentences.zh: 基于分数的扩散模型最近已被推广到无限维函数空间，其用途包括由偏微分方程产生的逆问题。

sentences.en: In the Bayesian formulation of inverse problems, the aim is to sample from a posterior distribution over functions obtained by conditioning a prior on noisy observations.
sentences.zh: 在逆问题的贝叶斯表述中，目标是从关于匿名噪声观测条件下先验的后验分布中进行采样。

sentences.en: While diffusion models provide expressive priors in function space, the theory of conditioning them to sample from the posterior remains open.
sentences.zh: 虽然扩散模型在函数空间中提供了表达力强的先验，但如何对其条件化以从后验中采样的理论仍然悬而未决。

sentences.en: We address this, assuming that either the prior lies in the Cameron-Martin space, or is absolutely continuous with respect to a Gaussian measure.
sentences.zh: 我们解决了这一问题，前提是先验要么位于 Cameron-Martin 空间中，要么关于高斯测度绝对连续。

sentences.en: We prove that the models can be conditioned using an infinite-dimensional extension of Doob's $h$-transform, and that the conditional score decomposes into an unconditional score and a guidance term.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，这些模型可以使用 Doob $h$ 变换的无限维推广来进行条件化，并且条件分数可分解为无条件分数与引导项之和。

sentences.en: As the guidance term is intractable, we propose a simulation-free score matching objective (called *Supervised Guidance Training*) enabling efficient and stable posterior sampling.
sentences.zh: 由于引导项难以处理，我们提出了一个无模拟的分数匹配目标（称为*有监督引导训练*），从而实现高效且稳定的后验采样。

sentences.en: We illustrate the theory with numerical examples on Bayesian inverse problems in function spaces.
sentences.zh: 我们用函数空间中贝叶斯逆问题的数值示例来说明这一理论。

sentences.en: In summary, our work offers the first function-space method for fine-tuning trained diffusion models to accurately sample from a posterior.
sentences.zh: 总之，我们的工作首次提出了对已训练扩散模型进行微调以准确地从后验中采样的函数空间方法。

title_en: Support-Proximity Augmented Diffusion Estimation for Offline Black-Box Optimization
title_zh: 面向离线黑盒优化的支持邻域增强扩散估计

sentences.en: Offline black-box optimization aims to discover novel designs with high property scores using only a static dataset, a task fundamentally challenged by the out-of-distribution (OOD) extrapolation problem.
sentences.zh: 离线黑盒优化旨在仅使用静态数据集发现具有高属性分数的新颖设计，这一任务从根本上受到分布外（OOD）外推问题的挑战。

sentences.en: Existing approaches typically bifurcate into inverse methods, which struggle with the ill-posed nature of mapping scores to designs, and forward methods, which often lack the distributional expressivity to quantify uncertainty effectively.
sentences.zh: 现有方法通常分为两类：逆向方法难以处理将分数映射到设计的病态性质，而正向方法往往缺乏有效量化不确定性的分布表达能力。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose \textbf{SPADE} (\textbf{S}upport-\textbf{P}roximity \textbf{A}ugmented \textbf{D}iffusion \textbf{E}stimation), a novel framework that reimagines forward surrogate modeling through the lens of conditional generative modeling.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了 \textbf{SPADE}\（\textbf{S}upport-\textbf{P}roximity \textbf{A}ugmented \textbf{D}iffusion \textbf{E}stimation），一种通过条件生成建模视角重新构想正向代理模型的新框架。

sentences.en: SPADE models the forward likelihood $p(y|\boldsymbol{x})$ using a diffusion model, but with two critical enhancements to tailor it for optimization: (1) a \emph{Calibrated Diffusion Estimation} module that enforces global consistency in statistical moments and pairwise rankings, and (2) a \emph{Support-Proximity Regularization} mechanism that implicitly internalizes the data manifold constraint $p(\boldsymbol{x})$ via kNN-based density estimation.
sentences.zh: SPADE 使用扩散模型对正向似然 $p(y|\boldsymbol{x})$ 建模，但为适配优化进行了两个关键增强：（1）\emph{Calibrated Diffusion Estimation}\模块，它在统计矩和成对排序方面强制执行全局一致性；以及（2）\emph{Support-Proximity Regularization}\机制，它通过基于 kNN 的密度估计隐式内化数据流形约束 $p(\boldsymbol{x})$。

sentences.en: Theoretically, we prove that our regularization is first-order equivalent to maximizing a Bayesian posterior with a valid design prior.
sentences.zh: 理论上，我们证明了我们的正则化在实现上等价于使用有效的设计先验最大化贝叶斯后验。

sentences.en: Empirically, SPADE achieves state-of-the-art performance across Design-Bench tasks and an LLM data mixture optimization benchmark.
sentences.zh: 实证上，SPADE 在 Design-Bench 任务以及一个 LLM 数据混合优化基准上取得了最先进的性能。

sentences.en: Our code is available at https://github.com/HarryYoung2018/spade.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/HarryYoung2018/spade 获取。

title_en: Suppress and Diversify: Refining Robust Pathways for Corruption Robustness
title_zh: 抑制与多样化：为抗损坏鲁棒性提炼鲁棒通路

sentences.en: Model robustness against natural image corruptions is essential for safety-critical applications.
sentences.zh: 模型对自然图像损坏的鲁棒性对安全关键型应用至关重要。

sentences.en: While existing methods primarily focus on implicit representation learning, we provide the first systematic exploration of computational pathways to explicitly characterize internal robustness.
sentences.zh: 虽然现有方法主要关注隐式表示学习，但我们首次系统探索了计算通路，以显式刻画内部鲁棒性。

sentences.en: We identify a progressive decay of robust features across network layers and establish a functional dependency between the prevalence of these features and model performance.
sentences.zh: 我们识别出鲁棒特征在网络各层间的渐进衰减，并建立了这些特征的普遍性与模型性能之间的功能依赖关系。

sentences.en: To exploit these insights, we propose Suppress and Diversify (S\&D), a non-intrusive refinement approach that enhances robustness by dynamically selecting robust pathways and diversifying them through symmetry-preserving transformations.
sentences.zh: 为利用这些洞见，我们提出了抑制与多样化（S\&D），一种非侵入式的提炼方法，通过动态选择鲁棒通路并借助保对称性变换使其多样化来增强鲁棒性。

sentences.en: S\&D is architecture-agnostic, parameter-free, and incurs zero test-time overhead.
sentences.zh: S\&D 与架构无关、无需参数，且不带来任何测试时开销。

sentences.en: Extensive evaluations across eight benchmarks demonstrate that S\&D consistently improves performance across multiple vision tasks, diverse backbones, and complex real-world scenarios, highlighting its broad efficacy and scalability.
sentences.zh: 跨八个基准的大量评估表明，S\&D 在多种视觉任务、不同骨干网络和复杂的真实世界场景中持续提升性能，凸显了其广泛的实效性和可扩展性。

title_en: SURF: Separation via Unsupervised Remixing Flow
title_zh: SURF：通过无监督重混流进行分离

sentences.en: The goal of single-channel source separation is to reconstruct $K$ sources given their mixture.
sentences.zh: 单通道源分离的目标是从混合物中重构 $K$ 个源。

sentences.en: In supervised settings where vast amounts of clean source data are available, this challenging, ill-posed problem has been addressed successfully by generative diffusion and flow-based prior models.
sentences.zh: 在可以获得大量干净源数据的监督场景中，这一具有挑战性的病态问题已通过生成扩散和基于流的先验模型得到成功解决。

sentences.en: However, access to such clean source samples is often limited, and even when available, supervised models are vulnerable to domain shifts.
sentences.zh: 然而，获取此类干净源样本往往受限，即使可以获得，监督模型也容易受到领域偏移的影响。

sentences.en: To bridge this gap, we present Separation via Unsupervised Remixing Flow (\textbf{SURF}), an unsupervised flow matching approach for source separation that learns directly from observed mixtures.
sentences.zh: 为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了\textbf{SURF}（通过无监督重混流进行分离），一种无监督流匹配方法，直接从观测到的混合物中学习源分离。

sentences.en: This method relies on a novel combination of state-of-the-art supervised flow matching and regression-based self-supervised techniques.
sentences.zh: 该方法依赖于最先进的监督流匹配与基于回归的自监督技术的全新组合。

sentences.en: At a high level, starting from a teacher model, we utilize a ``remixing'' step to bootstrap the learning of a student flow model from the teacher's estimates.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，从一个教师模型出发，我们利用“重混”步骤，根据教师的估计来引导学习一个学生流模型。

sentences.en: We provide insights into the objectives optimized by this approach and draw a novel connection to the Wake-Sleep algorithm.
sentences.zh: 我们深入分析了该方法所优化的目标，并建立了其与 Wake-Sleep 算法之间的新联系。

sentences.en: Empirical evaluations on image and audio benchmarks demonstrate that \textbf{SURF} establishes a new state-of-the-art, significantly outperforming existing unsupervised methods.
sentences.zh: 图像和音频基准上的评估表明，\textbf{SURF}\确立了新的最先进水平，显著优于现有无监督方法。

sentences.en: See our demo page for examples. https://google.github.io/df-conformer/surf/
sentences.zh: 查看我们的演示页面以获取示例：https://google.github.io/df-conformer/surf/

title_en: SURGE: Approximation and Training Free Particle Filter for Diffusion Surrogate
title_zh: SURGE：扩散代理的近似与训练无关粒子滤波

sentences.en: Data assimilation (DA) tackles the sequential estimation of a dynamical system’s latent state from noisy, partial observations.
sentences.zh: 数据同化（DA）处理从含噪、不完整的观测中顺序估计动态系统隐状态的问题。

sentences.en: In this paper, we study DA in a setting where the system dynamics are represented by a pretrained diffusion model used as a surrogate forecaster.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们研究这样一种 DA 设定：系统动力学由预训练的扩散模型表示，并用作代理预测器。

sentences.en: We focus on how to integrate incoming observations into the diffusion surrogate’s predictions to support continuous state correction and progressively refining the estimated trajectory over time.
sentences.zh: 我们关注如何将新到的观测融入扩散代理的预测中，以支持持续的状态校正，并随时间的推进逐步细化估计的轨迹。

sentences.en: After receiving noisy observations, the diffusion model is guided using the observation likelihood to steer the generation process toward observation-consistent states.
sentences.zh: 在收到含噪观测后，扩散模型利用观测似然进行引导，使生成过程朝向与观测一致的状态。

sentences.en: However, such guidance does not guarantee sampling from the true posterior.
sentences.zh: 然而，这种引导并不能保证从真实后验中采样。

sentences.en: Motivated by particle filtering methods, we represent the posterior distribution using an ensemble of particles.
sentences.zh: 受粒子滤波方法的启发，我们使用粒子集来表示后验分布。

sentences.en: We perform Sequential Monte Carlo over diffusion trajectories, working with their path measure.
sentences.zh: 我们在扩散轨迹上执行序贯蒙特卡洛方法，处理其路径测度。

sentences.en: We compute importance weights for generated particles and resample to focus on trajectories consistent with the observations.
sentences.zh: 我们为生成的粒子计算重要性权重，并重新采样以聚焦于与观测一致的轨迹。

sentences.en: This procedure corrects the generation dynamics, drives the particle approximation toward the desired posterior and leads to an approximation-free particle filtering method that rigorously fuses observational data with diffusion model simulations.
sentences.zh: 这一过程纠正了生成动力学，使粒子近似趋向所期望的后验，从而得到一种无需近似的粒子滤波方法，将观测数据与扩散模型模拟严格融合。

title_en: SURGE: Surrogate Gradient Adaptation in Binary Neural Networks
title_zh: SURGE：二值神经网络中的代理梯度自适应

sentences.en: The training of Binary Neural Networks (BNNs) is fundamentally based on gradient approximation for non-differentiable binarization operations (e.g., sign function).
sentences.zh: 二值神经网络（BNN）的训练从根本上依赖于对不可微的二值化操作（例如符号函数）的梯度近似。

sentences.en: However, prevailing methods including the Straight-Through Estimator (STE) and its improved variants, rely on hand-crafted designs that suffer from gradient mismatch problem and information loss induced by fixed-range gradient clipping.
sentences.zh: 然而，主流方法，包括直通估计器（STE）及其改进变体，依赖于手工设计，这类设计饱受梯度失配问题以及由固定范围梯度裁剪导致的信息损失之苦。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose SURrogate GradiEnt Adaptation (SURGE), a novel learnable gradient compensation framework with theoretical grounding.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了 SURrogate GradiEnt Adaptation（SURGE），一种具有理论基础的新型可学习梯度补偿框架。

sentences.en: SURGE mitigates gradient mismatch through auxiliary backpropagation.
sentences.zh: SURGE 通过辅助反向传播缓解梯度失配。

sentences.en: Specifically, we design a Dual-Path Gradient Compensator (DPGC) that constructs a parallel full-precision auxiliary branch for each binarized layer, decoupling gradient flow via output decomposition during backpropagation.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们设计了一个双通路梯度补偿器（DPGC），它为每个二值化层构建一个并行的全精度辅助支路，通过在反向传播过程中进行输出分解来解耦梯度流。

sentences.en: DPGC enables bias-reduced gradient estimation by leveraging the full-precision branch to estimate components beyond STE's first-order approximation.
sentences.zh: DPGC 利用全精度支路估计 STE 一阶近似之外的成分，从而实现偏置更小的梯度估计。

sentences.en: To further enhance training stability, we introduce an Adaptive Gradient Scaler (AGS) based on an optimal scale factor to dynamically balance inter-branch gradient contributions via norm-based scaling.
sentences.zh: 为进一步增强训练稳定性，我们引入了一种基于最优缩放因子的自适应梯度缩放器（AGS），通过基于范数的缩放动态平衡支路间的梯度贡献。

sentences.en: Experiments on image classification, object detection, and language understanding tasks demonstrate that SURGE performs best over state-of-the-art methods.
sentences.zh: 在图像分类、目标检测和语言理解任务上的实验表明，SURGE 优于各种最先进的方法。

title_en: Surgery: Mitigating Harmful  Fine-Tuning for Large Language Models via Attention Sink
title_zh: Surgery：通过注意力汇聚缓解大型语言模型的有害微调

sentences.en: Harmful fine-tuning can invalidate safety alignment of large language models, exposing significant safety risks.
sentences.zh: 有害微调可能使大型语言模型的安全对齐失效，从而暴露重大安全风险。

sentences.en: In this paper, we utilize the attention sink mechanism to mitigate harmful fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们利用注意力汇聚机制来缓解有害微调。

sentences.en: Specifically, we first measure a statistic named *sink divergence* for each attention head and observe that *different attention heads exhibit two different signs of sink divergence*.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们首先为每个注意力头度量一个名为*sink 散度*的统计量，并观察到*不同的注意力头表现出两种不同符号的 sink 散度*。

sentences.en: To understand its safety implications, we conduct experiments and find that the number of attention heads of positive sink divergence increases along with the increase of the model's harmfulness when undergoing harmful fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: 为理解其安全含义，我们进行了实验，发现当模型经历有害微调时，正 sink 散度注意力头的数量会随模型危害性的增加而增加。

sentences.en: Based on this finding, we propose a separable sink divergence hypothesis -- *attention heads associating with learning harmful patterns during fine-tuning are separable by their sign of sink divergence*.
sentences.zh: 基于这一发现，我们提出可分离的 sink 散度假说——*在微调过程中与学习有害模式相关的注意力头，可以通过其 sink 散度符号进行区分*。

sentences.en: Based on the hypothesis, we propose a fine-tuning-stage defense, dubbed Surgery.
sentences.zh: 基于这一假说，我们提出了一种微调阶段防御方法，命名为 Surgery。

sentences.en: Surgery utilizes a regularizer for sink divergence suppression, which steers attention heads toward the negative sink divergence group, thereby reducing the model’s tendency to learn and amplify harmful patterns.
sentences.zh: Surgery 利用一个用于抑制 sink 散度的正则化器，将注意力头引向负 sink 散度组，从而降低模型学习并放大有害模式的倾向。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that Surgery improves defense performance by 5.90\%, 11.25\%, and 9.55\% on the BeaverTails, HarmBench, and SorryBench benchmarks, respectively.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，Surgery 在 BeaverTails、HarmBench 和 SorryBench 基准上分别将防御性能提升了 5.90\%、11.25\% 和 9.55\%。

sentences.en: Source code is available on https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Surgery-A69E.
sentences.zh: 源代码可在 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Surgery-A69E 获取。

title_en: SurrogateSHAP: Training-Free Contributor Attribution for Text-to-Image (T2I) Models
title_zh: SurrogateSHAP：文本到图像（T2I）模型的免训练贡献归因

sentences.en: As Text-to-Image (T2I) diffusion models are increasingly used in real-world creative workflows, a principled framework for valuing contributors who provide a collection of data is essential for fair compensation and sustainable data marketplaces.
sentences.zh: 随着文本到图像（T2I）扩散模型在真实世界创意工作流中的应用日益增多，为提供数据集合的贡献者进行合理估值，已成为确保公平报酬和可持续数据市场的必要条件。

sentences.en: While the Shapley value offers a theoretically grounded approach to attribution, it faces a dual computational bottleneck: (i) the prohibitive cost of exhaustive model retraining for each sampled subset of players (i.e., data contributors) and (ii) the combinatorial number of subsets needed to estimate marginal contributions due to contributor interactions.
sentences.zh: 虽然 Shapley 值为归因提供了有理论依据的方法，但它面临双重计算瓶颈：（i）对每个采样的玩家（即数据贡献者）子集进行穷举式模型重训练的成本过高，以及（ii）由于贡献者之间的交互，估计边际贡献所需的子集数量呈组合式增长。

sentences.en: To this end, we propose **SurrogateSHAP**, a retraining-free framework that approximates the expensive retraining game through inference from a pretrained model.
sentences.zh: 为此，我们提出了 **SurrogateSHAP**，一种免重训练框架，通过预训练模型的推理来近似昂贵的重训练博弈。

sentences.en: To further improve efficiency, we employ a gradient-boosted tree to approximate the utility function and derive Shapley values analytically from the tree-based model.
sentences.zh: 为进一步提高效率，我们采用梯度提升树来近似效用函数，并从基于树的模型解析地推导 Shapley 值。

sentences.en: We evaluate SurrogateSHAP across three diverse attribution tasks: (i) image quality for DDPM-CFG on CIFAR-20, (ii) aesthetics for Stable Diffusion on Post-Impressionist artworks, and (iii) product diversity for FLUX.1 on Fashion-Product data.
sentences.zh: 我们在三个不同的归因任务上评估 SurrogateSHAP：（i）CIFAR-20 上 DDPM-CFG 的图像质量，（ii）后印象派艺术品上 Stable Diffusion 的美学质量，以及（iii）时尚产品数据上 FLUX.1 的产品多样性。

sentences.en: Across settings, SurrogateSHAP outperforms prior methods while substantially reducing computational overhead, consistently identifying influential contributors across multiple utility metrics.
sentences.zh: 在各种设定下，SurrogateSHAP 均优于先前方法，同时大幅降低计算开销，并在多种效用指标下持续识别出具有影响力的贡献者。

sentences.en: Finally, we demonstrate that SurrogateSHAP effectively localizes data sources responsible for spurious correlations in clinical images, providing a scalable path toward auditing safety-critical generative models.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们证明 SurrogateSHAP 能有效定位临床图像中导致虚假相关的数据来源，为审计安全关键的生成模型提供了一条可扩展的路径。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CFG-Attribution-15DD/
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CFG-Attribution-15DD/ 获取。

title_en: SurvDiff: A Diffusion Model for Generating Synthetic Data in Survival Analysis
title_zh: SurvDiff：用于在生存分析中生成合成数据的扩散模型

sentences.en: Survival analysis is a cornerstone of clinical research by modeling time-to-event outcomes such as metastasis, disease relapse, or patient death.
sentences.zh: 生存分析通过建模诸如转移、疾病复发或患者死亡等时间事件结局，是临床研究的基石。

sentences.en: Unlike standard tabular data, survival data often come with incomplete event information due to dropout, or loss to follow-up.
sentences.zh: 与标准表格数据不同，生存数据往往因脱失或失访而带有不完整的事件信息。

sentences.en: This poses unique challenges for synthetic data generation, where it is crucial for clinical research to faithfully reproduce both the event-time distribution and the censoring mechanism.
sentences.zh: 这给合成数据生成带来了独特的挑战，因为对临床研究而言，忠实重现事件时间分布和删失机制至关重要。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose SurvDiff, an end-to-end diffusion model specifically designed for generating synthetic data in survival analysis.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了 SurvDiff，一种专为在生存分析中生成合成数据而设计的端到端扩散模型。

sentences.en: SurvDiff is tailored to capture the data-generating mechanism by jointly generating mixed-type covariates, event times, and right-censoring, guided by a survival-tailored loss function.
sentences.zh: SurvDiff 旨在捕获数据生成机制，它在生存专门定制的损失函数引导下，联合生成混合类型协变量、事件时间和右删失。

sentences.en: The loss encodes the time-to-event structure and directly optimizes for downstream survival tasks, which ensures that SurvDiff (i) reproduces realistic event-time distributions and (ii) preserves the censoring mechanism.
sentences.zh: 该损失编码了时间事件结构，并直接针对下游生存任务进行优化，这确保了 SurvDiff（i）重现真实的事件时间分布，并且（ii）保留删失机制。

sentences.en: Across multiple datasets, we show that SurvDiff consistently outperforms state-of-the-art generative baselines in both distributional fidelity and survival model evaluation metrics across multiple medical datasets.
sentences.zh: 在多个数据集上，我们表明，在多个医学数据集的分布保真度和生存模型评估指标方面，SurvDiff 持续优于最先进的生成基线。

sentences.en: To the best of our knowledge, SurvDiff is the first end-to-end diffusion model explicitly designed for generating synthetic survival data.
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，SurvDiff 是第一个专门为生成合成生存数据而设计的端到端扩散模型。

title_en: SVD as a Fast Interpretability Method for Transformers
title_zh: SVD 作为 Transformer 的快速可解释性方法

sentences.en: Mechanistic interpretability of Transformer models commonly relies on training auxiliary proxy models, such as Sparse Autoencoders or Cross-Layer Transcoders.
sentences.zh: Transformer 模型的机制可解释性通常依赖训练辅助代理模型，例如稀疏自编码器或跨层转码器。

sentences.en: While effective, these post-hoc approaches introduce approximation bias and incur substantial computational overhead.
sentences.zh: 虽然有效，但这些事后方法会引入近似偏差，并带来可观的计算开销。

sentences.en: We propose an alternative, training-free interpretability framework that directly exploits the Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) of weight matrices in Transformer MLP sublayers.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了一种替代的、免训练的可解释性框架，它直接利用 Transformer MLP 子层权重矩阵的奇异值分解（SVD）。

sentences.en: By operating natively on model parameters, our method improves scalability while preserving fidelity to the original weights.
sentences.zh: 通过直接在模型参数上操作，我们的方法在保持对原始权重保真度的同时提高了可扩展性。

sentences.en: We show that the projection matrices of MLP sublayers admit a natural decomposition into orthogonal, interpretable rank-1 subspaces, which we term **Detector-Effector Units** (DEUs).
sentences.zh: 我们表明，MLP 子层的投影矩阵具有一种自然的分解结构，可分解为正交的、可解释的秩-1 子空间，我们称之为 **Detector-Effector Units**（DEU）。

sentences.en: Within each unit, a singular vector functions as a detector of input patterns and modulates a coupled effector vector that encodes output semantics.
sentences.zh: 在每个单元中，一个奇异向量一方面作为输入模式的检测器，另一方面调控一个编码输出语义的耦合效应向量。

sentences.en: Building on this structure, we introduce **Subspace Contribution Analysis** (SCA), a diagnostic method that quantifies the direct causal contribution of individual native subspaces to model predictions.
sentences.zh: 在此结构的基础上，我们引入了 **Subspace Contribution Analysis**（SCA），一种诊断方法，用于量化各个原生子空间对模型预测的直接因果贡献。

sentences.en: Experiments across the GPT-2 family demonstrate that our framework, **Native Network Anatomy** (NaNA), identifies dominant functional pathways with orders-of-magnitude efficiency gains over training-based interpretability baselines, while maintaining weight fidelity.
sentences.zh: 跨 GPT-2 系列的实验表明，我们的框架 **Native Network Anatomy**（NaNA）能以比基于训练的可解释性基线高出多个数量级的效率识别主要功能通路，同时保持权重保真度。

sentences.en: Our results suggest that SVD-based analyses provide a scalable and faithful alternative to learned proxy approaches for mechanistic interpretability.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果表明，基于 SVD 的分析为机制可解释性提供了一种可扩展且忠实的、可替代学习式代理方法的选择。

title_en: SVL: Empowering Spiking Neural Networks for Efficient 3D Open-World Understanding
title_zh: SVL：赋能脉冲神经网络实现高效 3D 开放世界理解

sentences.en: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) offer an energy--efficient route to 3D spatio--temporal perception, yet they lag behind Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs) due to weak pretraining and heavy inference stacks, limiting generalization and multimodal reasoning (e.g., zero--shot 3D classification and open--world QA).
sentences.zh: 脉冲神经网络（SNN）为 3D 时空感知提供了一条节能的路径，但由于预训练较弱、推理栈较重，它们相对于人工神经网络（ANN）仍显落后，限制了泛化和多模态推理（例如零样本 3D 分类和开放世界问答）。

sentences.en: We present a universal \textbf{S}pike--based \textbf{V}ision--\textbf{L}anguage pretraining framework (SVL) that equips SNNs with open--world 3D understanding while preserving end--to--end spike efficiency.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了一种通用的\textbf{S}pike-\textbf{b}ased \textbf{V}ision-\textbf{L}anguage 预训练框架（SVL），它为 SNN 赋予开放世界 3D 理解能力，同时保持端到端的脉冲效率。

sentences.en: SVL comprises two core components: (i) {Multi--scale Triple Alignment} (MTA), a label--free triplet contrastive objective aligning 3D, image, and text; and (ii) {Re--parameterizable Vision--Language Integration} (Rep--VLI), which converts offline text embeddings into lightweight weights for text--encoder--free inference.
sentences.zh: SVL 包含两个核心组件：（i）{Multi-scale Triple Alignment}（MTA），一种无标签的三元组对比目标，用于对齐 3D、图像和文本；（ii）{Re-parameterizable Vision-Language Integration}（Rep-VLI），它将离线文本嵌入转换为轻量级权重，从而实现免文本编码器的推理。

sentences.en: Moreover, we present the first fully spike--driven point Transformer, {Spike-driven PointFormer}, whose 3D spike--driven self--attention (3D-SDSA) reduces interactions to sparse additions, enabling faster, more efficient training.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们提出了第一个完全脉冲驱动的点 Transformer，{Spike-driven PointFormer}，其 3D 脉冲驱动自注意力（3D-SDSA）将交互简化为稀疏加法，从而实现更快、更高效的训练。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments show that SVL attains strong zero--shot 3D classification (85.4% top--1) and consistently outperforms prior SNNs on downstream tasks (e.g., +6.1% 3D cls, +2.1% DVS actions, +1.1% detection, +2.1% segmentation) while enabling open--world 3D question answering, sometimes outperforming ANNs.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，SVL 在零样本 3D 分类上取得了强劲结果（85.4% top-1），并在下游任务上持续优于先前的 SNN（例如 3D 分类 +6.1%、DVS 动作 +2.1%、检测 +1.1%、分割 +2.1%），同时支持开放世界 3D 问答，有时甚至超越 ANN。

sentences.en: To the best of our knowledge, SVL represents the first scalable, generalizable, and hardware-friendly paradigm for 3D open-world understanding, effectively bridging the gap between SNNs and ANNs in complex open-world understanding tasks.
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，SVL 代表了 3D 开放世界理解的第一个可扩展、可泛化且硬件友好的范式，有效弥合了 SNN 与 ANN 在复杂开放世界理解任务中的差距。

title_en: SVL: Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning as Survival Learning
title_zh: SVL：将目标条件强化学习视为生存学习

sentences.en: Standard approaches to goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (GCRL) that rely on temporal-difference learning can be unstable and sample-inefficient due to bootstrapping.
sentences.zh: 依赖时序差分学习的目标条件强化学习（GCRL）标准方法，由于引导式自举可能不稳定且样本效率低下。

sentences.en: While recent work has explored contrastive and supervised formulations to improve stability, we present a probabilistic alternative, called survival value learning (SVL), that reframes GCRL as a survival learning problem by modeling the distribution of time-to-goal from each state.
sentences.zh: 虽然近期工作已探索对比和监督式表述以提高稳定性，但我们提出了一种概率替代方案，称为生存价值学习（SVL），它通过从每个状态建模到达目标时间的分布，将 GCRL 重新表述为生存学习问题。

sentences.en: This structured distributional Monte Carlo perspective yields a closed-form identity that expresses the goal-conditioned value function as a discounted sum of survival probabilities, enabling value estimation via a hazard model trained via maximum likelihood on both event and right-censored trajectories.
sentences.zh: 这种结构化的分布蒙特卡洛视角产生了一个闭式恒等式，将目标条件价值函数表示为生存概率的折扣和，从而能够通过危险模型进行价值估计，该模型在事件轨迹和右删失轨迹上通过最大似然训练。

sentences.en: We introduce three practical value estimators, including finite-horizon truncation and two binned infinite-horizon approximations to capture long-horizon objectives.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了三种实用的价值估计器，包括有限视界截断和两种分箱无限视界近似，以捕获长视界目标。

sentences.en: Experiments on offline GCRL benchmarks show that SVL combined with hierarchical actors matches or surpasses strong hierarchical TD and Monte Carlo baselines, excelling on complex, long-horizon tasks.
sentences.zh: 在离线 GCRL 基准上的实验表明，SVL 与分层智能体相结合，能够匹敌或超越强大的分层 TD 和蒙特卡洛基线，并在复杂、长视界任务上表现出色。

title_en: SVRG and Beyond via Posterior Correction
title_zh: 通过后验修正实现的 SVRG 及其扩展

sentences.en: Stochastic Variance Reduced Gradient (SVRG) and its variants aim to speed-up training by using gradient corrections.
sentences.zh: 随机方差缩减梯度（SVRG）及其变体旨在通过使用梯度修正来加速训练。

sentences.en: In their decade of existence, these methods have never been connected to any Bayesian methods, at least not at a fundamental level.
sentences.zh: 在它们存在的这十年里，这些方法从未与任何贝叶斯方法建立联系，至少不是在根本层面上。

sentences.en: Here, we fill this gap and show surprising new connections of SVRG to a recently proposed Bayesian method called ‘posterior correction’.
sentences.zh: 在这里，我们弥合了这一空白，并展示了 SVRG 与一种近期提出的贝叶斯方法——“后验修正”——之间的惊人新联系。

sentences.en: Our main contribution is to show that SVRG can be recovered as a special case of posterior correction when applied over isotropic-Gaussian posteriors.
sentences.zh: 我们的主要贡献是证明了当在后验服从各向同性高斯分布的情况下应用时，SVRG 可以作为后验修正的一个特例被恢复。

sentences.en: Novel extensions of SVRG are automatically obtained by using more flexible exponential-family posteriors.
sentences.zh: 通过使用更灵活的指数族后验，可以自动获得 SVRG 的新扩展。

sentences.en: We derive two new such extensions by using Gaussian families: a Newton-like variant with novel Hessian corrections, and an Adam-like extension that scales to large problems.
sentences.zh: 我们利用高斯族推导出两个这样的新扩展：一个带有新颖 Hessian 修正的类牛顿变体，以及一个可扩展到大规模问题的类 Adam 扩展。

sentences.en: Our work is the first to connect SVRG to Bayes and use it to boost training.
sentences.zh: 我们的工作是第一个将 SVRG 与贝叶斯联系起来并利用它来加速训练的工作。

title_en: SWE-ABS: Adversarial Benchmark Strengthening Exposes Inflated Success Rates on Test-based Benchmark
title_zh: SWE-ABS：对抗性基准强化揭示基于测试的基准上虚高的成功率

sentences.en: The SWE-Bench Verified leaderboard is approaching saturation, with the top system achieving 78.80\%.
sentences.zh: SWE-Bench Verified 排行榜正在趋于饱和，顶尖系统达到了 78.80\%。

sentences.en: However, we reveal that this performance is inflated: our re-evaluation demonstrates that one in five ``solved'' patches from the top-30 agents are semantically incorrect, passing only because weak test suites fail to expose their errors.
sentences.zh: 然而，我们揭示这一性能是虚高的：我们的重新评估表明，前 30 名智能体中五分之一的“已解决”补丁在语义上是不正确的，它们之所以通过，只是因为薄弱的测试套件未能暴露其错误。

sentences.en: We present SWE-ABS, an adversarial framework that strengthens test suites through a two-stage pipeline: (1) coverage-driven augmentation utilizing program slicing to target untested code regions, and (2) mutation-driven adversarial testing that synthesizes plausible-but-incorrect patches to expose semantic blind spots.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 SWE-ABS，一种对抗性框架，通过两阶段流水线强化测试套件：（1）利用程序切片进行覆盖驱动的增强，以瞄准未测试的代码区域；（2）进行突变驱动的对抗性测试，合成看似合理但不正确的补丁，以暴露语义盲区。

sentences.en: On SWE-Bench Verified (500 instances), SWE-ABS strengthens 50.2\% of instances (a $25.1\times$ improvement over prior work) and rejects 19.78\% of previously passing patches.
sentences.zh: 在 SWE-Bench Verified（500 个实例）上，SWE-ABS 强化了 50.2\% 的实例（相较于先前工作有 $25.1\times$ 的提升），并拒绝了 19.78\% 个先前通过的补丁。

sentences.en: Consequently, the top agent's score decreases from 78.80\% to 62.20\%, causing significant leaderboard reshuffling (e.g., the top-ranked agent drops to 5th place).
sentences.zh: 其结果是，顶尖智能体的分数从 78.80\% 下降到 62.20\%，导致排行榜发生显著重排（例如，排名第一的智能体跌至第 5 位）。
